title.rendered: I found the best screen protectors for the Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra

content.rendered:
Foldable phones have changed the way I think about screen protection. On a regular flagship, it’s possible to use the phone bare for a few weeks. However, I don’t even consider it for my expensive Galaxy Fold. While Samsung includes a factory film on the inner screen, the cover display is still exposed to everyday scratches, fingerprints, and accidental drops.

To help you find the right protection, I compared some of the most popular screen protectors available for the Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra. In this guide, you’ll find my top recommendations, along with the pros, cons, and who each one is best suited for.

Why you need a screen protector on the Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra

The Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra is one of Samsung’s most expensive smartphones ever. That alone is enough reason to protect it.

Foldables introduce challenges that traditional phones don’t. The cover display is constantly exposed when the phone is closed. Even if you baby your phone, micro scratches appear surprisingly fast.

The inner display is a different story. Samsung already applies a factory-installed Ultra-Thin Glass (UTG) protective film. I generally don’t recommend replacing or removing it as it will void your warranty. For an extra layer of defense against scratches, only look for thin, flexible TPU or PET films that are specifically designed to adhere over the pre-installed factory layer.

Another reason I always install a protector is fingerprint resistance. Foldable OLED displays look incredible until they’re covered in smudges. A good oleophobic coating keeps the phone looking cleaner throughout the day.

How I chose the screen protectors

Instead of chasing flashy marketing claims, I looked for the things that actually matter in daily use.

  • Installation Experience: There’s nothing worse for a screen protector than misalignment. Products that include installation trays or alignment frames automatically move higher on my ranking since they’re significantly easier to install properly.
  • Touch Responsiveness: A Fold should feel just as smooth with a protector as without one. Any noticeable delay or reduced sensitivity quickly becomes frustrating.
  • Anti-Reflection: Outdoor visibility matters more than many people realize. Samsung’s own anti-reflective coating has become one of my favorite features on recent Galaxy devices.
  • Case Compatibility: Many protectors work perfectly until you install a protective case. I prioritized products designed to avoid edge lifting with popular cases.
  • Brand Reputation: I prefer brands that have been making good Galaxy accessories over brands that release mediocre products for new releases.

After years of using foldables, I’ve learned that a bad screen protector is often worse than having none at all. Poor adhesive, weak oleophobic coatings, reduced touch sensitivity, and annoying lifting around the edges can completely ruin the premium experience.

That’s why I focused on products from brands I have tested personally instead of simply picking the cheapest option.

Top 5 best screen protectors I recommend for the Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra

I compared Samsung’s own film against popular options from Spigen, TOCOL, and more to see which ones actually make sense for different buyers.

1. Samsung Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra Anti-Reflecting Film: Official fit

If I were buying only one screen protector today, this would probably be my first choice.

Samsung knows its own display better than anyone else. The official anti-reflective film is designed specifically to preserve the premium viewing experience rather than simply adding another plastic layer on top. You can protect the cover screen from scratches, dust and fingerprint smudges.

The biggest advantage is outdoor visibility. Anti-reflective coatings genuinely make a difference, especially under direct sunlight. Instead of increasing brightness, they reduce glare, making everything easier to read. This protector also maintains the smooth touch response Samsung intended for the phone.

Pros

  • Official Samsung accessory
  • Excellent anti-reflective coating
  • Maintains display clarity
  • Smooth touch experience

Cons

  • More expensive than generic films
  • Film doesn’t resist scratches as well as tempered glass
  • Limited protection against hard impacts

Best for: Users who want the closest experience to Samsung’s original display.

Check out on Amazon

2. Spigen GlasTR EZ FIT Pro Screen Protector: Best tempered glass option

Spigen has earned my trust over the years. Their EZ FIT installation system removes most of the frustration that comes with applying tempered glass. If you’ve ever ruined a protector because it went on crooked, you’ll appreciate the alignment tray.

The screen protector has multi-layered defense built with 9H+ alumina-silicate tempered glass, shatter-proof film, OCA layer, and silicon resin for military-grade drop protection. Spigen also delivers excellent oleophobic coatings that resist fingerprints better than many cheaper alternatives.

Pros

  • Premium tempered glass
  • Excellent installation tray
  • Great touch responsiveness
  • Minimal light scattering for ultra optical clarity

Cons

  • Costs more than budget competitors
  • Covers only the external display

Best for: Buyers who prioritize scratch resistance and easy installation.

Check out on Amazon

3. TOCOL Privacy Screen Protector: Must-have for outdoor goers

Privacy protectors aren’t for everyone. They slightly reduce brightness while narrowing viewing angles. However, if you frequently work in airports, trains, cafés, or offices, they’re incredibly useful.

TOCOL combines privacy protection with solid scratch resistance, making it a practical choice for professionals. You get a 25° anti-spy privacy filter, which keeps your display visible only when you’re looking at it straight on.

Beyond privacy, it focuses on everyday usability. The nano-coated surface is used to make the protector feel responsive and comfortable while resisting fingerprints, smudges, and water. TOCOL also mentions that the 9H+ tempered glass is 8 ft drop-tested.

Pros

  • Effective privacy filter
  • Scratch-resistant glass
  • Good value
  • Installation accessories included

Cons

  • Slightly darker display
  • Colors aren’t quite as vibrant

Best for: Professionals and frequent travelers.

Check out on Amazon

4. Ferilinso 3 Pack Inside Screen Protector: Full-body protection for Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra

This is the option I’d recommend for users specifically looking for an inner display protection film that’s designed for foldables. Unlike the Pixel 10 Fold Pro, you can apply the flexible film for peace of mind.

Ferilinso uses aerospace-grade materials infused with nano-ceramics, which the company claims deliver up to 10× stronger protection. The kit also stands out by including three sapphire camera lens protectors, designed to shield the large rear camera lenses without affecting photo quality.

For the back glass, the 9H+ tempered glass features 2.5D rounded edges for a comfortable feel and an oleophobic nano-coating that helps reduce fingerprints and oil smudges. Installation is beginner-friendly as the package includes all the necessary tools, and Ferilinso provides a step-by-step installation video to make the process even easier.

Pros

  • Designed for the folding display
  • Multiple replacements included
  • Bubble-resistant installation
  • Budget friendly

Cons

  • Installation requires patience
  • Less scratch-resistant than tempered glass

Best for: Users replacing a worn factory film or those wanting additional compatible inner-screen protection.

Check out on Amazon

5. TAURI 2 Pack Tempered Glass Screen Protector: Best budget pick

Not everyone wants to spend premium money on accessories. TAURI offers surprisingly good value without cutting too many corners. The key feature of this protector is a one-step application tray, which makes applying the protector quick and dust- and bubble-free.

You get full edge-to-edge coverage to protect the entire cover display from scratches and minor impacts. The 9H tempered glass provides protection against everyday hazards like keys, coins, and accidental drops.

Pros

  • Affordable
  • Multiple protectors included
  • 1-step installation kit with alignment tray

Cons

  • Coating isn’t as premium as Samsung or Spigen
  • Long-term durability may vary
  • More prone to fingerprints over time

Best for: Budget-conscious buyers.

Check out on Amazon

Things I learned while searching for Fold8 Ultra screen protectors

I realized that paying a little more usually saves frustration later. Cheap protectors often promise the same hardness ratings and features; however, their adhesion capabilities, edge design, and anti-fingerprint coating are inferior to those of premium alternatives.

Another takeaway is that installation matters almost as much as the protector itself. A premium protector installed poorly will look worse than a budget protector installed correctly.

Finally, my accessories list now includes the official ones. Years ago, I always skipped manufacturer-made screen protectors because they were expensive. Now, especially with foldables, Samsung’s official film deserves serious consideration because it’s designed to preserve one of the phone’s biggest strengths—its display quality.

Final verdict

If someone asked me today which protector to buy before their Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra arrives, my recommendations would be simple.

  • Buy the Samsung Anti-Reflecting Film if you care most about preserving the premium display experience and minimizing glare.
  • Get the Spigen GlasTR EZ FIT Pro if you want the perfect combination of durability, ease of application, and practicality for the cover screen.
  • Go with TOCOL when privacy matters more than maximum brightness.
  • Pick Ferilinso if you’re specifically looking for a compatible inner-screen film.
  • Choose TAURI if you’re shopping on a tighter budget and want a complete protection kit.

No matter which one you choose, installing a screen protector along with a good protective case before using your Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra is a smart investment. They can help prevent scratches, keep the display looking new, and save you from costly repairs in the future.

title.rendered: Wave Browser for iPhone and Mac: A productivity-focused alternative for Apple users

content.rendered:
Wave Browser is a Chromium-based Safari alternative with built-in productivity tools and an unusual environmental mission. It is available on Mac and iPhone, although the features are not identical on both platforms.

The main tradeoff is its business model: Yahoo is the default search engine, though you can change it in settings. Wave says revenue from search and other partnerships helps fund verified ocean cleanup through 4ocean.

What is Wave Browser?

Wave Browser combines a familiar interface with tools for managing tabs, editing PDFs, saving notes, blocking ads, and accessing messaging services without opening separate apps. It is free to download and is also available on Windows and Android. Some advanced features are promoted through Wave PRO, and availability can differ by device.

Wave Browser for Mac: Browse smarter on macOS

Wave Browser for Mac puts most of its productivity features in the browser and sidebar, making it easier to work without constantly switching apps.

Built-in productivity tools

You can annotate PDFs, convert files, create notes and reminders, translate pages, and access services such as WhatsApp, Messenger, and Instagram from the sidebar. These tools are most useful when you regularly keep communication and reference material open beside your work.

Tab management

Tab groups help separate work, research, shopping, and personal pages without spreading them across several windows.

Memory Saver

Memory Saver frees resources used by inactive tabs. It matters most when you leave many pages open during long work or research sessions.

Built-in ad blocker

Wave advertises a free built-in ad blocker, which can reduce intrusive ads, trackers, and pop-ups without another extension. It will not necessarily block every ad or tracker.

Wave also promotes additional AI and ad-blocking capabilities through Wave PRO, so check what your installed version includes before paying for an upgrade.

Familiar interface and impact tracker

The Chromium-style interface should feel familiar if you have used Chrome or Edge. Its homepage also includes a live tracker for the Wave community’s ocean-cleanup progress.

However, Safari still has the advantage if you rely on deeper Apple integration such as iCloud Keychain, Handoff, and Apple Pay. The broader Safari vs. Chrome comparison reflects much of the same ecosystem tradeoff.

Wave Browser for iPhone: Browse Smarter on iOS

Wave Browser for iPhone is free and currently requires iOS 17 or later. The mobile app focuses on straightforward browsing, bookmarks, privacy controls, and the community impact tracker; do not assume every desktop sidebar tool is available on iPhone.

Privacy features

Incognito mode avoids retaining local history, cookies, and temporary site data after you close the session. It does not hide your activity from websites, an employer or school network, or your internet provider.

The App Store privacy label says the app may collect identifiers and usage data that are not linked to your identity. That is useful context if privacy is one of your main reasons for leaving Safari.

Built-in password manager

Wave can save and autofill login credentials. Before relying on it as your main password manager, confirm that its storage and cross-device syncing match how you plan to use it on iPhone and Mac.

Personalized browsing

You can organize bookmarks, save pages to a reading list, and keep frequently used sites within easy reach. These are familiar browser features, but they make the move from Safari less disruptive.

What the AppEsteem certification means

AppEsteem currently lists specific Windows and macOS versions of Wave Browser as actively certified. Its requirements focus on transparent installation, consent, monetization, and avoiding deceptive or unwanted app behavior.

That certification is useful reassurance about distribution practices, but it is not the same as a complete independent security or privacy audit.

How Wave supports verified ocean cleanup

Through its certified partnership with 4ocean, a portion of Wave’s revenue supports cleanup crews removing plastic and trash from oceans, rivers, and coastlines. In other words, browsing helps fund the program; opening one tab does not remove a fixed amount of waste by itself.

Wave reported 100,026 pounds removed as of April 2026, with work across the United States, Indonesia, and the Dominican Republic. The longer-term commitment is 300,000 pounds by 2028.

Should you switch to Wave Browser?

Wave is worth trying if its Mac productivity tools and cleanup-funding model appeal to you. Keep Safari if seamless Apple-device syncing, Keychain, Handoff, and native system integration matter more.

Wave Browser has earned the SourceForge Leader Award for three consecutive seasons (Winter, Spring, and Summer 2026) based on outstanding customer reviews. The Summer 2026 recognition placed Wave Browser among the top 5% of more than 100,000 reviewed software products on SourceForge in the Web Browsers and Eco-Friendly Web Browsers categories, demonstrating consistently positive user feedback over time.

You can test Wave without making it your default immediately. If it fits your routine, follow the steps to change the default browser on Mac or choose a default browser on iPhone.

title.rendered: MacBook Air shortages push some deliveries into September

content.rendered:
Apple’s M5 MacBook Air is reportedly becoming difficult to find, with some U.S. orders now slipping into September. Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman reports that retail sources described new shipments as more constrained than they could remember.

The shortage is unusual for one of Apple’s mainstream Macs. Gurman says Apple has started steering some buyers toward the base MacBook Pro, while certain marketing materials now carry a “MacBook Air subject to availability” warning.

Higher-memory models face the longest waits

MacRumors checked Apple’s U.S. online store on August 2 and found estimated delivery times ranging from two to six weeks. Configurations with more unified memory appeared to have the longest delays.

Availability can vary by size, memory, storage, color, and location. Some standard models may still be available for pickup or faster delivery, so buyers will need to check the estimate for their exact configuration.

Apple has not issued a separate statement about the current MacBook Air shortage or said when supply will return to normal.

The shortage follows a $200 price increase

The tighter supply comes just over a month after Apple raised prices across Macs and other products. The MacBook Air’s U.S. starting price climbed from $1,099 to $1,299 in June, even though the M5 model had launched only in March.

Apple blamed that broader increase on sharply rising memory and storage costs as AI data centers consume more chips. The same component crunch had already disrupted Apple’s MacBook Pro and Mac Studio plans.

Gurman’s report points to both memory and silicon constraints behind the Air shortage. Strong demand may also be adding pressure, but Apple has not disclosed sales or supply figures for the model. For now, the clearest effect is longer waits—especially for buyers who want more than the base memory configuration.

excerpt.rendered: The M5 MacBook Air is reportedly in short supply, with higher-memory models facing the longest waits and some U.S. orders slipping into September.

title.rendered: Apple’s smart glasses could become a health companion, but not at launch

content.rendered:
Apple reportedly wants its upcoming smart glasses to grow into a health and fitness companion. Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman reports that Apple is exploring such experiences for future vision products, though they are unlikely to ship with the first display-free glasses expected next year.

The clearest sign is a hiring effort inside Apple’s Vision Products Group. According to the report, the team wants someone to shape future health, well-being, and fitness experiences while connecting spatial computing, wearables, consumer health, and human behavior.

Apple has not settled on specific health features

Gurman’s report does not name sensors, health metrics, or a finished fitness service for the glasses. That leaves the practical details open.

Cameras could eventually help analyze movement, while audio could deliver coaching during a run or workout. Apple already uses personalized spoken guidance through Workout Buddy, which is receiving more workout insights in watchOS 27. A glasses-based version is only a possibility for now, not a confirmed feature.

The first model is expected to lean on cameras, microphones, speakers, and AI rather than an in-lens display. Apple is separately rumored to be planning a WWDC 2027 reveal for its privacy-focused smart glasses, putting the device closer to Meta’s Ray-Ban glasses than Vision Pro.

Vision Pro’s weight reportedly ended an earlier fitness plan

Apple had explored bringing Fitness+ to Vision Pro, Gurman reports. The idea would have let people follow workouts in the headset while its body-tracking system analyzed their movements and recorded progress toward their activity rings.

The project was reportedly dropped because of technical hurdles and the headset’s weight. That helps explain why lighter glasses are a more natural long-term fit for fitness, even without a display.

It also follows Apple’s broader move toward smaller AI wearables. The company has reportedly prioritized smart glasses over a planned Vision Pro revamp, suggesting it sees everyday eyewear as the more practical path to a wider audience.

Apple has not announced its smart glasses or their health plans. Even if the current roadmap holds, the first model may arrive without this health layer, leaving the fuller fitness vision for a later generation.

title.rendered: Snapchat’s new Now Playing feature brings live Spotify sharing to Snap Map

content.rendered:
Music is coming to Snap Map. Snapchat has announced Now Playing, a feature that adds your current song to your Bitmoji so friends can see what you’re listening to while browsing the map.

If you’ve ever received a “What song is this?” message after posting a Story, Now Playing eliminates the need to keep sharing Spotify links. Once you connect your Spotify account and choose who can see your activity, your currently playing track appears above your Bitmoji on Snap Map.

Here’s everything you need to know.

Share your current Spotify track on Snap Map

The feature debuts with Spotify support, making it the first music streaming service to work with Now Playing. Spotify is the first streaming service to support Now Playing, suggesting more music platforms could be added later.

After linking Spotify with Snapchat, your current track appears alongside your Bitmoji on Snap Map. Every time the music changes on Spotify, Snap Map reflects it automatically, whether you’ve switched to a different playlist, skipped a song, or started a new album.

Once you’ve linked Spotify, Snap Map automatically updates whenever your music changes. Whether you switch playlists, skip a track, or start a new album, friends will only see the song you’re currently listening to—not your playlists, recently played songs, favorite artists, or listening history.

Friends who spot a song they like can open it directly in Spotify, save it to Liked Songs, or check out Spotlight videos that use the same audio.

How to connect Spotify to Snapchat

  1. Open Snapchat.
  2. Go to Snap Map, Settings, Sounds, or a Friend Profile.
  3. Tap the Spotify option and sign in.
  4. Choose who can see your listening activity.

Once connected, Now Playing works automatically whenever you’re listening to Spotify.

You’re in control of who sees your music

Now Playing uses the same audience settings as Snap Map, so there isn’t another privacy menu to configure.

You can choose who sees your listening activity:

  • Friends
  • Friends on the Map
  • Selected Friends
  • No One

You can change these settings at any time or turn off music sharing entirely.

Only the current song is visible

Snapchat only shares the track you’re currently listening to. Friends won’t be able to view your playlists, favorite artists, recently played songs, or listening history. If you don’t open Snapchat for about 24 hours, your music stops appearing on Snap Map until you become active again.

Snap Map is becoming more than a location-sharing tool

Snap Map has evolved well beyond sharing your location. It now brings together Stories, local places, events, recommendations, and live music sharing in one place. With Now Playing, friends can discover what you’re listening to in real time without leaving Snapchat. Spotify is the first supported streaming service, but Snap has hinted that additional platforms could join in the future.

Would you like to see Apple Music, YouTube Music, or other streaming services supported next? Let us know in the comments.

acceptedAnswer.text: You can use John Wick Sprite in Reload, standard Battle Royale, and Zero Build.

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, besides the John Wick Sprite, there are the John Wick (Pen & Ink) skin, the Simpsons-style John Wick skin, a 9mm Baba Yaga pistol, and John Wick's dog sidekick.

aioseo_head_json.author_bio:
Vikhyat has a bachelor’s degree in Electronic and Communication Engineering and over five years of writing experience. His passion for technology and Apple products led him to the tech writing space, where he specializes in writing App features, How-to guides, and troubleshooting guides for fellow Apple users. 

 

About Vikhyat Rishi

  • Vikhyat has over five years of experience writing consumer tech content.
  • During his association with Smartprix and Beebom, Vikhyat has tested, tested, and reviewed numerous gadgets, including but not limited to smartphones, TVs, and more.
  • His passion for technology and Apple products led him to iGeeksBlog, where he specializes in writing How-to and troubleshooting guides for fellow Apple enthusiasts.

Experience

Vikhyat embarked on his journey in consumer technology writing in 2019, driven by his passion for technology. He has sharpened his skills through associations with Smartprix and Beebom, where he extensively tested and reviewed various gadgets, focusing mainly on smartphones. Currently, Vikhyat specializes in crafting How-to and troubleshooting guides for the Apple ecosystem at iGeeksBlog. When not typing away on his MacBook Air, he loves exploring the real world.

title.rendered: How I stopped Siri from randomly activating on my AirPods

content.rendered:
I didn’t realize how often Siri interrupted me until one morning during a workout. I adjusted my AirPods to get a better fit, and suddenly Siri popped up asking, “How can I help?” stopping my music. If you’ve had the same experience, you’re not alone.

The good news is that you can stop Siri from interrupting your listening experience. While Apple doesn’t let you completely disable Siri from the AirPods themselves, there are several settings that prevent accidental activations and unwanted voice announcements.

In this guide, I’ll show you exactly how to turn off Siri on AirPods, explain what each setting actually does, and share which changes made the biggest difference for me.

Can you completely turn off Siri on AirPods?

Here’s something Apple doesn’t make very clear: You can’t completely disable Siri from the AirPods themselves. Because AirPods don’t process Siri requests on their own or connect to the internet independently.

Instead, they simply act as a remote that triggers Siri on the connected Apple device, such as your iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, Apple TV, or Apple Vision Pro. When you disable Siri on your AirPods, you’re only preventing the AirPods from activating Siri on that connected device.

That means you’ll lose voice commands like making calls, sending messages, asking questions, controlling music, getting directions, and performing other hands-free tasks. If you only want to stop accidental activations, changing the AirPods gesture is usually enough without disabling Siri completely.

Method 1: Remove Siri From AirPods controls

If Siri keeps opening because you accidentally touch or press your AirPods, the easiest fix is to remove Siri from the AirPods controls. This prevents a tap, press, or squeeze from launching Siri while still letting you use your AirPods normally.

For AirPods Pro, AirPods 3, and AirPods 4

  1. Connect your AirPods to your iPhone and wear at least one of them.
  2. Open Settings and tap your AirPods near the top of Settings.
  3. Scroll down to Press and Hold AirPods and select Left or Right.
  4. Replace Siri with Noise Control or other available options.

Personally, I switched both earbuds’ controls to Noise Control. I use Transparency Mode every day, while I almost never intentionally launch Siri.

For AirPods 1 and AirPods 2

Older AirPods use double-tap controls.

Here’s how to change them:

  1. From Settings, tap your connected AirPods.
  2. Select the Left or Right AirPods.
  3. Replace Siri with:
    • Play/Pause
    • Next Track
    • Previous Track

This simple adjustment prevents countless accidental Siri activations.

Method 2: Turn off “Hey Siri” activation

Removing Siri from your AirPods touch or press controls is only half the solution. I still encountered Siri interruptions and realized voice activation is still enabled. That’s because the touch controls and voice activation are two separate ways to launch Siri.

Disabling the touch gesture prevents accidental activations caused by pressing or tapping your AirPods, but voice activation remains active until you turn it off on your iPhone. Therefore, Siri continues to activate whenever it detects the wake phrase while you’re wearing your AirPods.

  1. Open Settings
  2. Tap Apple Intelligence & Siri (or Siri, depending on your iPhone model).
  3. Select Talk to Siri or Talk & Type to Siri.
  4. Here, choose Off to disable Siri.

On older versions of iOS, turn off Listen for “Hey Siri” instead.

This single setting solved about 80% of my accidental Siri launches. I noticed the biggest improvement while walking outdoors, where background conversations and traffic noise sometimes confused Siri into activating.

Method 3: Stop Siri from reading messages on AirPods

Sometimes it may seem like Siri is activating on its own when it’s actually reading incoming messages through the Announce Notifications feature. It happened to me while listening to a serious podcast once, and I turned it off immediately to avoid future interruptions.

  1. Open Settings.
  2. Tap Notifications.
  3. Select Announce Notifications under Siri.
  4. Toggle off Announce Notifications.

I have kept the Announce Notifications enabled for CarPlay to reduce distractions while driving. To ensure this, go to Apple Intelligence & Siri, select Announce Notifications, toggle off Headphones, and set CarPlay to your desired notifications.

Method 4: Turn off Siri call announcements

Another feature many people mistake for Siri itself is Announce Calls. When enabled, Siri reads the caller’s name before your phone rings.

If you don’t like this behavior:

  1. Launch Settings.
  2. Tap Apple Intelligence & Siri (or Siri on other iPhone models)
  3. Select Announce Calls and choose Never to stop Siri from announcing incoming calls.

Worry not; you’ll still be able to answer or decline calls using your AirPods controls. I prefer this setting because I usually glance at my Apple Watch or phone anyway. Hearing Siri announce every incoming call quickly became unnecessary noise.

Method 5: Disable head gestures that trigger Siri

If you use AirPods Pro (2nd generation) or newer supported AirPods, head gestures can trigger Siri without touching your AirPods. For example, nodding or shaking your head may respond to Siri or interact with Siri notifications. If you don’t use this feature or find it activating accidentally, you can turn it off.

If you accidentally trigger Siri through head gestures:

  1. Connect your AirPods to your iPhone or iPad.
  2. Open the Settings app.
  3. Tap Bluetooth.
  4. Tap the i button next to your AirPods.
  5. Scroll down and tap Head Gestures.
  6. Turn Head Gestures Off.

After disabling this feature, nodding or shaking your head will no longer interact with Siri. You can still use Siri manually through your AirPods controls or by saying “Siri” (if voice activation is enabled).

How to turn Siri back on

If you ever decide you miss Siri, turning it back on is easy.

Simply:

  • Re-enable Talk to Siri
  • Restore Siri as an AirPods control
  • Turn Announce Notifications back on if you prefer voice alerts

Everything can be changed in just a minute or two, and you can resume using Siri.

Troubleshooting: Siri still keeps activating itself?

If Siri keeps activating even after changing the settings above, don’t panic. These fixes usually solve the issue.

  • Restart Your AirPods: Place them back in the charging case, wait about 30 seconds, and reconnect them.
  • Forget and Reconnect Your AirPods: Open Settings, tap your AirPods, select Forget This Device, and pair them again. This refreshes many AirPods settings.
  • Update iOS: Apple frequently improves Siri behavior through software updates. Running an outdated version of iOS can sometimes cause unexpected Siri activations
  • Check Your AirPods Firmware: Firmware updates install automatically while charging, but they can fix bugs related to Siri and touch controls. It’s worth ensuring your AirPods are up to date.

Stop Siri from interrupting your AirPods

After experimenting with every Siri setting Apple offers, I’ve come to one conclusion: Most people don’t actually want to disable Siri on their AirPods—they want uninterrupted audio.

Apple clearly envisions Siri as a hands-free assistant that’s always ready to help. In practice, though, many users spend more time dismissing accidental activations than intentionally using it.

Since making those changes, my AirPods have felt noticeably less intrusive. Music plays without random interruptions, workouts stay focused, and meetings are free from unexpected voice announcements.

  • How to fix AirPods static noise quickly
  • How to use two AirPods with one Mac simultaneously

keyPoints.title: Siri Runs Through iPhone or iPad, Not AirPods
keyPoints.explanation: You can't disable Siri directly on AirPods, but you can turn off its interactions to prevent unwanted triggers.

keyPoints.title: Change AirPods Controls to Disable Siri Activation
keyPoints.explanation: You can reassign press or touch gestures on your AirPods via settings to prevent Siri from activating when used.

keyPoints.title: Disable 'Hey Siri' Voice Activation
keyPoints.explanation: Turning off the 'Hey Siri' feature stops the voice command from waking Siri unexpectedly on your AirPods.

keyPoints.title: Turn Off Siri Message Announcements to Avoid Distractions
keyPoints.explanation: Disabling or customizing Siri's message notifications can prevent it from reading alerts aloud when using AirPods.

keyPoints.title: Optional: Disable Siri System-Wide for Complete Control
keyPoints.explanation: Switching off Siri entirely on your device disables it both on your iPhone and AirPods, giving you full control over voice interactions.

title.rendered: How to get Spider-Man Brand New Day skins in Fortnite

content.rendered:
The Spider-Man Brand New Day collab has landed in Fortnite, with the Item Shop receiving a range of skins inspired by the titular superhero, The Punisher, and Hulk. These cosmetics come in addition to Spider-Man’s Web Shooters mythic-rarity item, which was also recently brought ahead of this partnership.

After weeks of anticipation and teasing, Spider-Man Brand New Day cosmetics are finally up for grabs until August 9, 2026, by 5 PM PT or 8 PM ET. Moreover, each of the superhero skins is priced at 1,500 V-Bucks in the Shop. Below, you can check how you can purchase these outfits within Fortnite.

Steps to get Spider-Man Brand New Day skins in Fortnite

  1. In Fortnite, go to the Shop tab.
  2. Next, scroll down to the Spider-Man promo and select your desired skin.
  3. Lastly, press the Purchase button to confirm your decision.

Alternatively, Fortnite players can also grab hold of the Spider-Man and The Punisher skins and other related cosmetics, in one-go, by purchasing the Brand New Day Bundle worth 2,400 V-Bucks. On the other hand, the Hulk skin can also be bought through the Hulk Bundle, priced at 1,800 V-Bucks, which comes bundled with a few other relevant extras.

Other Spider-Man Brand New Day cosmetics in Fortnite

1. Arachno-pack (back bling)

Price: 300 V-Bucks
Also available in: Brand New Day Bundle

2. Web Flail (pickaxe)

Price: 800 V-Bucks
Also available in: Brand New Day Bundle

3. Spider-sense (emote)

Price: 300 V-Bucks
Also available in: Brand New Day Bundle

4. Frank’s Goodie Bag (back bling)

Price: 300 V-Bucks
Also available in: Brand New Day Bundle

5. Frank’s Arsenal (pickaxe)

Price: 800 V-Bucks
Also available in: Brand New Day Bundle

6. Gamma Chamber (back bling)

Price: 300 V-Bucks
Also available in: Hulk Bundle

7. Demolisher (pickaxe)

Price: 800 V-Bucks
Bundled extra item: Warning: Gamma Rays spray
Also available in: Hulk Bundle

8. Hulk Smash (emote)

Price: 300 V-Bucks
Also available in: Hulk Bundle

Wrapping up

Since the newly released Spider-Man Brand New Day was among the most anticipated films of 2026, its Fortnite collab was similarly a buzzing topic among players. Now that both are out at last, we can expect the synergy to translate into strong in-game engagement from Marvel enthusiasts and Fortnite fans alike. Regardless, suffice to say it’s an exciting period in entertainment media for Spider-Man faithfuls.

FAQs

How many times has the MCU Spider-Man been added to Fortnite?

Two times. Apart from this instance, MCU Spider-Man was previously also added around the time of Spider-Man: No Way Home’s release in 2021.

Which other MCU heroes have appeared in Fortnite previously?

Other MCU characters who were added to Fortnite in the past include Captain America, Iron Man, Captain America Sam Wilson, Loki, Scarlet Witch, among others.

Do Photographic Styles affect video recording?

While nothing has been confirmed yet, there is a good chance that Fortnite may do an MCU collab again around the launch of Avengers: Doomsday in December, given their long affiliation with Marvel.

  • How to get MCU Iron Man and Captain America skins in Fortnite
  • How to get the Mongraal skin in Fortnite
  • How to get Squid Game skins in Fortnite
  • How to get X-Men skins in Fortnite

title.rendered: How to unlock Panda Team Jr sidekick for free in Fortnite

content.rendered:
Panda Team Jr sidekick is currently available to claim for free in Fortnite, thanks to the ongoing Cuddles And Chaos event. It is one of the rewards that you get for completing the event’s namesake quest by participating in Fortnite maps from the brand-new “Creatures” category.

The Cuddles And Chaos event is centered on sidekicks and incentivizes players to indulge in Fortnite’s creature games. Below, you can go through all that you need to do in order to unlock the Panda Team Jr sidekick. The most suitable maps for completing this quest are also shared in this article.

How to get Panda Team Jr sidekick in Fortnite

To get your hands on the Panda Team Jr sidekick, you need to complete a total of eight Cuddles and Chaos quests. These quests can only be done by playing creature-based Fortnite Creative maps, such as Sidekick Wars. Each quest requires earning 80,000 XP through matches played in eligible maps.

It’s worth noting that, during this process, you will also unlock the Moth Banner Icon as a log-in reward. On the other hand, Mothman’s Lure Loading Screen and Bamboo Blast Wrap will be unlocked after completing four and six of such quests, respectively.

Upon successfully unlocking the Panda Team Jr sidekick, you can further obtain more sidekick styles and other cosmetics by completing more quests. Among the available sidekick rewards are Overalls Style, Bamboo Heart Reaction, Green Overalls Style, and Rain Shoots And Leaves Emote.

Fortnite Creative maps for Cuddles And Chaos quest

The following creature-based maps are among the most popular in Fortnite, at the time of writing. Moreover, these maps offer a fair amount of gameplay variety, ranging from strategy to simulation.

Rounding up

The freshly added creature-based maps have certainly turned the tables on how sidekicks operate in Fortnite. Earlier, they were a passive aspect and only treated as a Fortnite cosmetic to personalize your experience. But now, these characters have a greater stake in the gameplay, thanks to having their own dedicated category in Fortnite Creative.

Over the coming weeks, it will be interesting to track how creature-based maps trend among Fortnite players. It’s reasonable to think Epic Games would expect these tiny critters to get as popular in the community as the addition of sprites at the start of the current in-game season.

title.rendered: Spotify brings Running Mode to premium users on iPhone

content.rendered:
Spotify is rolling out Running Mode for Premium subscribers on iPhone, introducing a new workout feature that creates personalized playlists based on a runner’s planned pace and training session. The feature is initially available in the United States, the United Kingdom, and Australia.

Available through Spotify’s Fitness hub, Running Mode allows users to build playlists around their target pace and workout type. Spotify says the feature is designed to better match music with different styles of running and training sessions.

Runners can customize every workout

After opening Running Mode from Spotify’s Fitness hub, users can either choose from 25 preset workouts or create a completely custom session.

Rather than selecting a pre-made playlist, users first choose the type of run they want to complete, such as a steady run, interval workout, or pyramid session.

They can then customize the workout by setting its duration, selecting a target pace, and choosing their preferred music genre.

Once the workout is configured, Spotify automatically generates a playlist tailored to the selected workout and running pace. Users can also enable English voice prompts for guidance during the session.

At launch, Running Mode is available only to Spotify Premium subscribers using an iPhone in the US, UK, and Australia.

Spotify is revisiting an old idea with a new approach

This isn’t Spotify’s first attempt at building features for runners.

The company previously offered a pace-based running feature before discontinuing it in 2018. Running Mode takes a different approach by replacing automatic pace detection with manual workout planning, giving users greater control over both their training session and music selection.

The new feature also aligns with Spotify’s broader push into fitness experiences.

Earlier this year, the company partnered with Peloton to bring guided fitness classes to Premium subscribers. Running Mode expands that effort by adding another workout-focused feature that helps users plan a run before the music starts.

With personalized playlists, workout customization, and integrated voice prompts, Spotify is aiming to make its app a more capable companion for fitness enthusiasts.

Would you use Spotify’s new Running Mode during your workouts? Let us know in the comments below.

His passion for technology and Apple products led him to the tech writing space, where he specializes in writing App features, How-to guides, and troubleshooting guides for fellow Apple users. 

 

About Vikhyat Rishi

  • Vikhyat has over five years of experience writing consumer tech content.
  • During his association with Smartprix and Beebom, Vikhyat has tested, tested, and reviewed numerous gadgets, including but not limited to smartphones, TVs, and more.
  • His passion for technology and Apple products led him to iGeeksBlog, where he specializes in writing How-to and troubleshooting guides for fellow Apple enthusiasts.

Experience

Vikhyat embarked on his journey in consumer technology writing in 2019, driven by his passion for technology. He has sharpened his skills through associations with Smartprix and Beebom, where he extensively tested and reviewed various gadgets, focusing mainly on smartphones. Currently, Vikhyat specializes in crafting How-to and troubleshooting guides for the Apple ecosystem at iGeeksBlog. When not typing away on his MacBook Air, he loves exploring the real world.

title.rendered: Apple blames App Store changes and gaming for slower services growth

content.rendered:
Apple says changes to App Store regulations in the United States and several international markets are beginning to affect its Services business, even as the segment delivered a record June-quarter performance.

During Apple’s third-quarter fiscal 2026 earnings call, CFO Kevan Parekh said the Services division generated a record $30.7 billion in revenue, up 12% year over year. Despite the strong performance, growth slowed compared to recent quarters, marking the segment’s first sequential slowdown since 2022.

App Store changes and gaming weighed on growth

According to Parekh, Apple’s App Store business is beginning to feel the effects of regulatory and policy changes introduced over the past year.

Alongside softer revenue from mobile gaming, updates to the App Store’s business model in several regions contributed to slower Services growth during the quarter.

Apple now offers developers greater flexibility around app distribution and payment options in markets including Japan, Brazil, and the European Union. In the United States, the company is currently complying with a court ruling that allows developers to direct users to external payment methods.

Although Apple is appealing that decision, Parekh noted that the App Store still delivered its highest June-quarter revenue despite the regulatory changes.

The absence of a major theatrical release also played a role

Apple said another reason for the slower growth was the lack of a major theatrical release during the quarter.

Parekh pointed to a difficult year-over-year comparison, noting that the same quarter last year benefited from the release of F1: The Movie, which boosted revenue across Apple’s entertainment services.

With no comparable blockbuster release this year, Apple’s Services business faced a much tougher comparison, contributing to the slower growth rate.

Apple does not break out App Store revenue separately, but the marketplace remains one of the company’s largest contributors to its Services segment.

Regulatory scrutiny of the App Store continues worldwide, and the outcome of Apple’s ongoing legal appeal in the United States could have a significant impact on how the App Store operates in the years ahead.

Do you think App Store rule changes will have a bigger impact on Apple’s Services business in future quarters? Share your thoughts in the comments below.

title.rendered: Apple may make heavy AI users pay through iCloud+

content.rendered:
Apple may use iCloud+ to recover some of the growing cost of running its cloud-based AI features. During Apple’s fiscal Q3 2026 earnings call, CEO Tim Cook said the company expects to offer iCloud+ upgrade options for people who make heavy use of Apple Intelligence.

Cook was careful not to present this as a finished pricing plan. He said it was still early and Apple had not fully decided how it would balance AI compute costs with what users pay.

iCloud+ is already becoming Apple’s paid AI tier

Apple had already laid the groundwork at WWDC 2026. Its Apple Intelligence announcement said some features relying on powerful server models, including image generation, would have daily limits. Most iCloud+ plans offer increased access, although Apple has not published the exact caps for each tier.

In practice, supported-device owners get basic access to Apple Intelligence features, while paying iCloud+ customers get more server-based requests.

Apple needs more cloud processing as its AI grows more capable. The rebuilt Siri in iOS 27 can use personal context, understand what is on screen, and take actions across apps. More complex requests cannot always run on an iPhone and have to move to Apple’s cloud infrastructure.

Apple’s most demanding AFM 3 cloud model can run through Private Cloud Compute on NVIDIA GPUs in Google Cloud. That gives Apple more processing power, but every server-side request carries a cost that on-device AI does not.

Apple has not announced a paid Siri plan

For now, Apple’s direction looks more like higher usage limits bundled with iCloud+ than a separate Siri subscription. Basic access could remain included, while heavier users pay for a higher tier.

The important caveat is that Apple has not announced prices, exact limits, or which iCloud+ plans would qualify. Cook’s answer confirms the route Apple is considering, not the final bill users will see.

title.rendered: MacBook Ultra design may reach cheaper MacBook Pro in 2027

content.rendered:
Apple’s rumored MacBook Ultra may not keep its new look for long. Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman reports that an entry-level 14-inch MacBook Pro planned for 2027 is expected to resemble Apple’s upcoming high-end laptops while using a standard M7 chip.

The cheaper model is reportedly code-named K104. The high-end 14-inch and 16-inch machines are known internally as K114 and K116 and may arrive between late 2026 and early 2027. If those dates hold, the premium design could spread down the lineup within roughly a year.

Apple has not announced any of these laptops, and the “MacBook Ultra” name is still rumored.

The design may spread, but OLED and touch might not

The high-end models are expected to bring an OLED touchscreen and Dynamic Island-style camera cutout, along with a thinner and lighter body. They would be Apple’s first touchscreen Macs.

Bloomberg’s roadmap only says the entry-level K104 will resemble the K114 and K116. It does not confirm that the cheaper MacBook Pro will also get OLED or touch support. Apple could reuse the overall chassis and smaller camera cutout while keeping the premium display features exclusive to its costlier models.

That distinction matters because the high-end machine is expected to cost more than the current MacBook Pro. A shared exterior would let Apple modernize the whole lineup without erasing the reason to pay extra for the top model.

Apple’s MacBook rollout could get complicated

Bloomberg says Apple first plans to refresh the entry-level 14-inch MacBook Pro with an M6 chip and the current design. The M7 version with the newer look would then follow in 2027, creating an unusually short gap between updates.

The high-end K114 and K116 models may take a different route. They are expected to launch with M5 Pro and M5 Max chips despite introducing the new design, followed by M7 Pro and M7 Max versions later in 2027.

The exact branding remains unclear. Apple could place a MacBook Ultra above the MacBook Pro or use it to replace today’s high-end Pro models. Either way, Bloomberg’s roadmap suggests the design itself will not remain an Ultra-only perk.

The current MacBook Pro design is five years old

Apple last redesigned the MacBook Pro in 2021. That version became thicker and restored MagSafe, HDMI, and the SD card slot after years of relying heavily on USB-C.

The rumored redesign appears focused on making the laptop thinner and updating the display rather than rethinking the MacBook from scratch. Buyers who mainly want the new look may eventually get it on the entry-level model, while OLED and touch could remain the real Ultra upgrades.

title.rendered: Murder Mystery 2 (MM2) codes (August 2026)

content.rendered:
Update: Verified the latest Murder Mystery 2 Codes on August 25, 2026

MM2 codes have rewarded players with a variety of exclusive collectibles over the years, including rare knives, unique weapon skins, and even limited-time pets. These items are highly sought after because they often become unavailable once the promotional code expires, making them valuable additions to any player’s inventory.

After a code expires, the associated reward can no longer be claimed directly and is usually only obtainable through trading with other players. Since these limited items can increase in demand over time, it’s always a good idea to redeem new MM2 codes as soon as they are released so you don’t miss out on free collectibles.

All working Murder Mystery 2 codes

None

Expired Murder Mystery 2 codes

2015, AL3X, BANNED, C0RL, COMB4T2, D3NIS, FL4M, G003Y, G1FT3D, HW2017, INF3CT3D, N30N, NATUREUPDATE, PATR1CK, PR1SM, R3PT1L3, SK00L, SK3TCH, SUB0, TH3N3XTL3V3L

How to redeem MM2 codes

The code box sits inside Inventory rather than the main Roblox menu.

  1. Open Murder Mystery 2 on Roblox.
  2. Select Inventory on the left.
  3. Find the EnterCode box in the bottom-right corner.
  4. Paste the code exactly as shown.
  5. Select Redeem and check your inventory.

The box may not appear on PlayStation, while the Redeem button is currently unresponsive on other platforms.

Why an MM2 code may not work

  • It has expired: Developers can disable codes without warning.
  • A character is wrong: Watch for lookalikes such as 0 and O, or 1 and I.
  • The capitalization changed: Treat codes as case-sensitive and copy them exactly.
  • You already redeemed it: A code only awards its item once per account.
  • Your server is old: Join a fresh server if a code launches alongside an update.
  • It has an extra requirement: Check the original announcement for any platform, version, or community rule.

Where to find new MM2 codes

New codes are most likely to appear through the game’s creator or official community channels. These are the useful pages to watch:

  • Murder Mystery 2 on Roblox
  • Nikilis on X
  • Nikilis on YouTube
  • Murder Mystery 2 Discord

Those channels mix codes with general updates, so bookmark this page if you only want the short working list. If you want more free rewards, check out the latest Azure Latch codes, Peroxide codes, and our complete list of all Roblox game codes.

In case you missed

  • Military Tycoon codes
  • DOORS codes
  • Driving Empire codes

title.rendered: Roblox Peroxide codes (August 2026)

content.rendered:
Update: Verified the latest Peroxide Codes on August 21, 2026

Building the perfect character in Peroxide often means rerolling your clan, stats, or other abilities, and that can quickly drain your stockpile of Product Essence. Instead of spending hours grinding for more, redeeming the latest codes is the easiest way to grab free rewards and keep experimenting with different builds.

The newest Peroxide codes currently reward free Product Essence and even an extra character slot, giving you more flexibility to try new playstyles without starting from scratch. Since these codes are usually released during major updates and tend to expire without much warning, it’s best to claim them as soon as they’re available.

All working Peroxide codes

  • 445kLikesYipee: 20 Product Essence and 1 new slot (NEW)
  • 4thJuly2026: 15 Product Essence

Only these two Peroxide codes are safely confirmed to work. Copy them exactly because the code box is case-sensitive.

Expired Peroxide codes

How to redeem Peroxide codes

Peroxide keeps its redemption box inside Settings. You must complete the opening tutorial and reach the main city before the menu becomes available.

  1. Open Peroxide on Roblox.
  2. Complete the opening tutorial.
  3. Select the graph icon in the top-left corner.
  4. Open Settings.
  5. Paste a working code into the code box.
  6. Press Enter to claim the reward.

Why your Peroxide code is not working

Most failed redemptions come down to one of these problems:

  • The code expired after an update or milestone event.
  • A capital letter is wrong, or an extra space was pasted.
  • You already redeemed the code on that Roblox account.
  • Your server is running an older version of the game.
  • You have not finished the opening tutorial.

Copy and paste the code first. If a new code still fails, leave the game, join a fresh server, and try it once more.

Where to find more Peroxide codes

New Peroxide codes tend to arrive with updates, milestones, holidays, or server fixes. Check the Peroxide Discord and Peroxide Trello after a patch, or bookmark this page for the shorter verified list.

If you want more free rewards, check out the latest The Forge codes, Azure Latch codes, and our complete list of all Roblox game codes.

title.rendered: I fixed my disappearing Instagram messages in less than a minute

content.rendered:
I don’t use disappearing chats very often, so I was surprised when one of my Instagram conversations kept clearing itself every time I left the chat. At first, I thought it was a bug because nothing looked unusual. The messages would appear while I was chatting, then disappear the next time I opened the conversation.

After checking the chat settings, I realized Disappearing Messages was turned on. Once I turned it off, new messages stayed in the conversation as expected.

If your Instagram chats are doing the same thing, you don’t need to reinstall the app or start a new conversation. Here’s how to disable the feature and what to do if your messages are still disappearing afterward.

What is the Disappearing Messages feature on Instagram?

Disappearing Messages is an optional privacy feature that automatically removes new messages after they’ve been seen and you leave the conversation. New messages are meant to be temporary, disappearing after they’ve been seen and you leave the conversation.

The feature works on a per-conversation basis, which means turning it off in one chat won’t affect your other conversations.

If you prefer to keep your messages, you can disable it at any time.

How to turn off Disappearing Messages on Instagram

If your messages keep disappearing, you don’t have to dig through Instagram’s settings. You can turn it off directly from the conversation in a second.

  1. Open the Instagram conversation where Disappearing Messages is enabled.
  2. Swipe up from the bottom of the chat and release.
  3. Wait a moment until Instagram confirms that Disappearing Messages has been turned off.
  4. Send a new message to make sure it stays in the conversation after you leave the chat.

If the swipe doesn’t work:

  1. Tap the person’s name at the top of the chat.
  2. Tap Disappearing Messages.
  3. Select the Off option.

What happens after you turn Disappearing Messages off?

After disabling the feature, I sent a few test messages and closed the chat several times to make sure everything was working normally. The messages stayed in the conversation each time I reopened it.

Turning off Disappearing Messages doesn’t restore messages that have already been removed. It simply prevents future messages from disappearing automatically.

Messages still disappearing? Try these fixes

If the setting is already off and your chats still aren’t behaving normally, here’s what I’d check next.

1. Update Instagram

Instagram changes its messaging features regularly. Running an older version of the app can cause missing settings or unexpected behavior.

Install the latest version from the App Store or Google Play Store, then check the conversation again.

2. Restart Instagram

Sometimes Instagram doesn’t apply the change straight away. Close Instagram completely, reopen it, and return to the conversation before testing again.

3. Make sure you’re looking at the right chat

Disappearing Messages are controlled separately for each conversation.

If multiple chats are affected, you’ll need to disable the feature in each one individually.

4. Check whether messages were unsent

It’s easy to mistake disappearing messages for unsent ones.

Anyone in the conversation can remove a message they’ve sent. Those messages won’t come back, even if Disappearing Messages is turned off.

5. Sign out and sign back in

If chat settings seem stuck or aren’t updating, logging out and back into Instagram can refresh your account data.

Can the other person turn it back on?

Yes. Since Disappearing Messages is a chat setting, anyone in the conversation can turn it back on. If your messages start disappearing again, check whether the feature has been re-enabled.

Back to normal chats…

In my case, the fix only took a few seconds. Once I turned off Disappearing Messages, new messages stayed in the chat as expected. If your conversations keep clearing after you leave them, this should be the first setting you check.

If your Instagram conversations keep disappearing every time you leave the chat, checking this setting should be your first step. In most cases, it solves the problem in less than a minute.

Did this fix your disappearing Instagram chats? Let us know what worked for you, or share any issue you ran into in the comments.

keyPoints.title: Understanding Vanish Mode on Instagram
keyPoints.explanation: Vanish Mode allows users to send disappearing messages in conversations, with messages disappearing after being seen or when the chat is closed, similar to Snapchat.

keyPoints.title: Accidental Activation and Privacy Notifications
keyPoints.explanation: Vanish Mode is often turned on accidentally due to its simple swipe gesture and not requiring mutual consent; Instagram notifies users if screenshots are taken during this mode.

keyPoints.title: Reasons to Disable Vanish Mode
keyPoints.explanation: Turning off Vanish Mode helps retain conversation records, prevents confusion, and maintains professionalism in business communications.

keyPoints.title: How to Turn Off Vanish Mode on Instagram
keyPoints.explanation: Vanish Mode can be disabled by opening the chat, swiping up from the bottom of the screen, and releasing to deactivate the feature on iPhone or Android devices.

keyPoints.title: Troubleshooting Vanish Mode Issues
keyPoints.explanation: If Vanish Mode won't turn off, solutions include force quitting the app, updating Instagram, or ensuring a stable network connection.

Update: Verified the latest Azure Latch Codes on August 24, 2026

Azure Latch codes are one of the easiest ways to claim free Cash and Style Coins without spending hours grinding matches. These rewards let you unlock new Styles, customize your character, and experiment with different builds much faster, giving you more flexibility as you progress through the game.

Most new codes are released alongside major updates, milestone celebrations, or limited-time events, but they often expire without much notice. That’s why I recommend redeeming the latest Aiku update codes as soon as they’re available so you don’t miss out on valuable freebies that can speed up your progression.

All working Azure Latch codes

  • MASTERYKAISER: Free Yen (NEW)
  • SORRYFORLATERELEASE: Free Explosion (NEW)
  • KAISERISNEXTWEEKNOWORRIES: Free Rewards
  • PINGOVERHAUL: Free Rewards

How to redeem Azure Latch codes

Join the developer’s Roblox community first; otherwise, valid codes may fail.

  1. Join the Azure Latch Roblox community.
  2. Open Azure Latch on Roblox.
  3. Click Menu at the bottom of the screen.
  4. Select the Rewards tab.
  5. Paste a working code into the Code box.
  6. Click Redeem to claim the reward.

Why an Azure Latch code may not work

  • It has expired: Update and compensation codes can stop working without warning.
  • There is a typo: Copy and paste the code, then remove any extra spaces.
  • The capitalization is wrong: Keep every uppercase and lowercase letter exactly as listed.
  • You already used it: Each code works once per Roblox account.
  • You have not joined the community: Join the official Roblox community and restart the game.
  • Your server is old: Rejoin a fresh server after an update or new code drop.

Where to find more Azure Latch codes

New codes usually arrive with updates, milestones, shutdown fixes, or special events. The best places to watch are:

  • Azure Latch Discord
  • Azure Latch Roblox community
  • Azure Latch on Roblox

The Discord is usually the fastest source, but bookmarking this page saves you from digging through announcements and testing outdated strings.

title.rendered: Amazing Spider-Man 4K wallpapers every Marvel fan needs on their iPhone

content.rendered:
Spider-Man has always been more than a superhero to me. Every time a new movie gets announced, my phone somehow ends up with a new wallpaper because every version of Peter Parker represents a different chapter of life. 

With Spider-Man: Brand New Day on the horizon, we wanted to create a high-resolution iPhone wallpaper collection that captures different emotions that every Spider-Man fan connects with. Whether you’re teaming Peter Parker, Miles Morales, Spider-Gwen, or even Spider-Ham, this collection is for you. 

Table of Contents
  • Download Spider-Man iPhone Wallpapers
    • 1. Spider-Man in action
    • 2. Spider-Man close-up portrait
    • 3. A Bold Red Spider-Man wallpaper
    • 4. Spider-Man slinging from your Dynamic Island
    • 5. A love letter to Spider-Man's comic history
    • 6. Spider-Man Camping Wallpaper
    • 7. Bold Spider-Man Concept Art Wallpaper
    • 3. Spider-Man in Flames Wallpaper
    • 4. Spider-Man Poster Wallpaper
    • 5. Comic Style Spider-Man Wallpaper
    • 6. Miles Morales Spider-Man Wallpaper
    • 7. Scarlet Spider Wallpaper
    • 8. Cute Anna May Parker Wallpaper
    • 9. Spider-Gwen Comic Wallpaper
    • 10. Pavitr Prabhakar Spider-Man Wallpaper
    • 11. Across the Spider-Verse Team Wallpaper
    • 12. Spider-Ham Aesthetic Wallpaper
    • 13. Noir Spider-Man Wallpaper
    • 14. Miles Morales vs Spider-Man 2099 Wallpaper
    • 15. Animated Miles Morales Wallpaper
    • 16. Spider-Man Aesthetic Wallpaper
    • 17. Miles Morales Wallpaper
    • 18. Spider-Man Multiverse Action Wallpaper
    • 19. Spider-Woman Wallpaper
    • 20. Spider-Man Meme Wallpaper
  • Make Spider-Man swing straight to your home screen!

Download Spider-Man iPhone Wallpapers

I have curated the enchanting wallpapers from X creators such as SpaceWall, Papers app, aestheticsguyy, and more. Tap the Download button below each wallpaper to grab it in full quality. Don’t miss the last one — it’s my personal favorite! 

1. Spider-Man in action

The first wallpaper immediately reminded me of an intense battle of Spider-Man. The cracked ground, sparks flying around him, and lightning in the distance create a cinematic atmosphere that feels straight out of a Marvel finale.

Download

2. Spider-Man close-up portrait 

Spider-Man doesn’t need explosions to look incredible. This close-up portrait with rain droplets covering the mask proves that. The background with soft golden bokeh lights makes Spider-Man’s iconic white eyes the focus, creating a great Spatial Screen wallpaper.

Download

3. A Bold Red Spider-Man wallpaper 

If your phone deserves something that instantly grabs attention, this is probably the standout wallpaper in the collection. I liked how the glowing white eyes contrast beautifully against the deep red background.

The design feels almost like a modern comic book cover, mixing digital art with classic Marvel aesthetics.

Download

4. Spider-Man slinging from your Dynamic Island 

This one instantly made me smile. Spider-Man is hanging upside down from Dynamic Island while casually throwing a victory sign. This playful energy is exactly what makes him different from almost every other superhero.

Download

5. A love letter to Spider-Man’s comic history 

Next one is a tribute to where everything began. Spider-Man stands confidently in front of black-and-white comic panels featuring classic artwork from decades of Marvel history. It’s perfect for anime lovers as well.

Download

6. Spider-Man Camping Wallpaper

Bring your screen to life with this bold and moody Spider-Man wallpaper. The big moon and camping tent in the background bring a touch of mystery and grit.

Download

7. Bold Spider-Man Concept Art Wallpaper

If you love dark and bold wallpapers, this one is perfect. Featuring Spidey with dramatic neon colors, the wallpaper brings an action movie-like vibe to your phone.

Download

8. Spider-Man in Flames Wallpaper

This AI-generated wallpaper makes your iPhone screen stand out with its eye-catching vibrant colors.

Download

9. Spider-Man Poster Wallpaper

Dive into the Marvel Cinematic world with this bold Spider-Man poster! Grab it now to amp up your decor!

Download

10. Comic Style Spider-Man Wallpaper

Featuring a sharp design and intense focus on Spidey, this wallpaper has a perfect comic-book flair. Ideal for every true fan!

Download

11. Miles Morales Spider-Man Wallpaper

Celebrate the heart of the Spider-Verse with this high-definition Miles Morales wallpaper that highlights the hero’s complexity and courage.

Download

12. Scarlet Spider Wallpaper

Meet Ben Reilly, the Scarlet Spider. Created by Jackal, he’s darker and more aggressive — this wallpaper captures his raw edge perfectly.

Download

13. Cute Anna May Parker Wallpaper

Sweet, soft, and full of hope — carry the bright face of Anna May Parker wherever you go with this adorable wallpaper.

Download

14. Spider-Gwen Comic Wallpaper

She doesn’t need saving — she is the savior. This bold and empowering Spider-Gwen design radiates strength and independence.

Download

15. Pavitr Prabhakar Spider-Man Wallpaper

Straight from the streets of Mumbattan, this wallpaper brings India’s very own Spider-Man to life with cultural flair and color.

Download

16. Across the Spider-Verse Team Wallpaper

An epic, high-energy collage celebrating every Spider-Variant. This one’s for the fans who live and breathe the multiverse.

Download

17. Spider-Ham Aesthetic Wallpaper

Cute meets chaotic in this wallpaper featuring Peter Porker aka Spider-Ham. A must-have for meme lovers and animation fans.

Download

18. Noir Spider-Man Wallpaper

Step into the shadows with Spider-Man Noir — a 1930s detective look paired with slick monochrome visuals and mystery vibes.

Download

19. Miles Morales vs Spider-Man 2099 Wallpaper

An epic showdown between two Spider-Titans. Choose your side in this powerful clash wallpaper inspired by Across the Spider-Verse.

Download

20. Animated Miles Morales Wallpaper

Miles free-falling into the multiverse. Dramatic, mysterious, and visually stunning — this one’s made for true fans.

Download

21. Spider-Man Aesthetic Wallpaper

Minimalist and moody, this wallpaper shows Spidey amidst nature, reflecting a quiet moment before the storm.

Download

22. Miles Morales Wallpaper

A blend of innocence, humor, and heroism. This Miles Morales wallpaper captures his unique energy and charm.

Download

23. Spider-Man Multiverse Action Wallpaper

A dynamic visual of Spidey mid-swing through multiverse chaos — perfect for those who love action-packed home screens.

Download

24. Spider-Woman Wallpaper

Celebrate the superhero and the mother. Spider-Woman’s strength and nurturing spirit take center stage in this powerful design.

Download

25. Spider-Man Meme Wallpaper

Because no Spider-Verse is complete without that meme. Carry the most iconic Spider-Man point scene in glorious 4K.

Download

Make Spider-Man swing straight to your home screen! 

Spider-Man has never been inspiring because he’s the strongest hero. He’s inspiring because he struggles, fails, gets back up, and keeps trying anyway.

That’s why these wallpapers feel more personal than just movie artwork. Every image captures the spirit of the Spider-Verse and Peter Parker that we’ve all connected with at some point. As we wait for the next Spider-Man movie, this collection is a small reminder of why we keep coming back to him generation after generation.

Which wallpaper is your favorite? Let us know in the comments below!

title.rendered: Qualcomm expects a bigger hit from Apple’s modem shift

content.rendered:
Qualcomm says its business with Apple will shrink faster than previously expected as the iPhone maker continues replacing Qualcomm’s 5G modems with its own in-house chips.

CEO Cristiano Amon shared the updated outlook in an interview with Reuters following the company’s third-quarter earnings, signaling that Apple’s modem transition is progressing more quickly than Qualcomm had originally anticipated.

The chipmaker had previously expected Apple-related revenue to fall to around 20% of its former level with the launch of the next iPhone generation. Amon now says the decline will be even steeper because Qualcomm will supply fewer components than originally forecast, with the sharper drop expected to begin during the company’s fourth fiscal quarter.

Apple continues moving away from Qualcomm modems

Apple has been steadily replacing Qualcomm’s cellular modems with its own custom-designed chips.

The company’s in-house modem has already debuted in the iPhone 16e, iPhone 17e, and iPhone Air, while multiple reports suggest the transition will continue across the upcoming iPhone 18 lineup.

Apple is also reportedly developing its next-generation C2 modem, which is expected to deliver improved network performance, better power efficiency, and enhanced overall connectivity.

As Apple’s custom modem technology expands to more iPhone models, Qualcomm is expected to supply fewer modem components with each new generation, further reducing one of its long-standing revenue streams.

Qualcomm is looking beyond the iPhone

Alongside the expected decline in Apple-related revenue, Qualcomm also announced that it will increase prices beginning September 1 to help offset rising supply chain costs.

Amon told Reuters that the company is passing those higher costs on to customers as part of its broader strategy to manage increasing manufacturing and supply chain expenses.

Looking ahead, Qualcomm expects its business to become less dependent on smartphones. The company believes continued growth in areas such as data centers, AI infrastructure, and other connected technologies will help offset declining revenue from Apple as the iPhone maker continues expanding its in-house modem strategy.

Apple and Qualcomm’s current patent licensing agreement remains in effect through March 2027. It remains unclear whether Apple will renew the agreement or complete its transition to proprietary modem technology across its entire iPhone lineup before the deal expires.

Do you think Apple will eventually eliminate Qualcomm modems from every iPhone, or will the two companies continue working together beyond 2027? Let us know your thoughts in the comments below.

aioseo_head_json.author_bio:
Vikhyat has a bachelor’s degree in Electronic and Communication Engineering and over five years of writing experience. His passion for technology and Apple products led him to the tech writing space, where he specializes in writing App features, How-to guides, and troubleshooting guides for fellow Apple users. 

 

About Vikhyat Rishi

  • Vikhyat has over five years of experience writing consumer tech content.
  • During his association with Smartprix and Beebom, Vikhyat has tested, tested, and reviewed numerous gadgets, including but not limited to smartphones, TVs, and more.
  • His passion for technology and Apple products led him to iGeeksBlog, where he specializes in writing How-to and troubleshooting guides for fellow Apple enthusiasts.

Experience

Vikhyat embarked on his journey in consumer technology writing in 2019, driven by his passion for technology. He has sharpened his skills through associations with Smartprix and Beebom, where he extensively tested and reviewed various gadgets, focusing mainly on smartphones. Currently, Vikhyat specializes in crafting How-to and troubleshooting guides for the Apple ecosystem at iGeeksBlog. When not typing away on his MacBook Air, he loves exploring the real world.

title.rendered: Google simplifies Gemini’s thinking controls and Android notifications

content.rendered:
Google is cleaning up several Gemini controls as the app adds more features. 9to5Google reports that the changes are appearing across Android and the web, although the new notification menu is still in a limited rollout.

Extended thinking now takes one tap

Gemini previously placed its Thinking level options inside a second dropdown. Users had to open it and choose between Standard, the default for most questions, and Extended thinking for more complex prompts.

The new design removes Standard from that extra menu and shows only Extended thinking as a direct option. Standard is still the default; Google has simply removed an unnecessary step. The change is already appearing widely on Android and the web.

Android users get separate notification switches

Gemini’s Android app is also gaining four notification categories in the account menu. These let users choose which parts of the app can send alerts:

  • Daily Brief
  • Scheduled actions
  • Responses to questions that take longer
  • Product updates and tips

That means someone can keep alerts for finished responses or recurring tasks while muting product tips. Google introduced Daily Brief alongside Gemini Spark at I/O 2026, so the new switches should make those proactive features less intrusive.

These controls are not widely available yet. The report only identifies the new menu on Android, so iPhone users may not see the same switches.

Spark tasks are easier to scan

The Gemini Spark screen on Android now sorts tasks into tabs for All, Scheduled, Needs input, In progress, and Completed. Google has also replaced the old menu button with a search icon for finding a task directly.

The redesign arrives shortly after Google began rolling Spark out to AI Pro subscribers in the US. None of these interface changes add a new AI capability, but the notification controls should make Gemini easier to live with as scheduled, and background tasks become more common.

excerpt.rendered: Gemini now offers one-tap Extended thinking, granular Android notification controls, and a cleaner Spark task view, though parts are still rolling out.

title.rendered: WhatsApp is working on an Android widget for instant voice messages

content.rendered:
WhatsApp is developing a new Android home screen widget that could let users record and send voice messages without first opening the app. The feature was spotted in the latest WhatsApp beta for Android, although it has not yet been rolled out to beta testers.

According to WABetaInfo, tapping the widget will open a dedicated recording interface where users can record a voice message before selecting one or more recipients. The shortcut is designed to reduce the number of steps required to send voice notes, making the process faster and more convenient for people who use the feature regularly.

How the voice message widget works

The new widget is expected to appear as a resizable 3×1 home screen shortcut.

When tapped, it opens a dedicated voice recording screen within WhatsApp, complete with controls to record, pause, resume, or discard a voice message before sending it.

After finishing the recording, users can select one or multiple recipients through a contact picker and send the voice message directly from the recording interface.

The widget is not intended to replace WhatsApp’s existing voice messaging workflow. Instead, it serves as an optional shortcut that users can place on their Android home screen for quicker access to voice messages.

Still unavailable for beta testing

Although the feature has been discovered in the latest WhatsApp beta build, it has not yet been enabled for beta testers, meaning users cannot try it at this time.

As with many upcoming WhatsApp features, the widget will likely undergo additional testing before eventually rolling out to the stable Android app. WABetaInfo first uncovered the feature while examining the latest beta version.

The voice message widget follows another Android home screen widget that WhatsApp has been developing, which allows users to view recent Status updates directly from the home screen without opening the app.

If released, the new shortcut could make sending voice notes significantly faster, especially for users who rely on voice messaging throughout the day.

Would you add a dedicated voice message widget to your Android home screen? Let us know your thoughts in the comments below.
