aioseo_head_json.author_bio:
Vikhyat has a bachelor’s degree in Electronic and Communication Engineering and over five years of writing experience. His passion for technology and Apple products led him to the tech writing space, where he specializes in writing App features, How-to guides, and troubleshooting guides for fellow Apple users. 

 

About Vikhyat Rishi

  • Vikhyat has over five years of experience writing consumer tech content.
  • During his association with Smartprix and Beebom, Vikhyat has tested, tested, and reviewed numerous gadgets, including but not limited to smartphones, TVs, and more.
  • His passion for technology and Apple products led him to iGeeksBlog, where he specializes in writing How-to and troubleshooting guides for fellow Apple enthusiasts.

Experience

Vikhyat embarked on his journey in consumer technology writing in 2019, driven by his passion for technology. He has sharpened his skills through associations with Smartprix and Beebom, where he extensively tested and reviewed various gadgets, focusing mainly on smartphones. Currently, Vikhyat specializes in crafting How-to and troubleshooting guides for the Apple ecosystem at iGeeksBlog. When not typing away on his MacBook Air, he loves exploring the real world.

title.rendered: This hidden trick lets you lock WhatsApp Web with a password

content.rendered:
I always assumed locking my laptop whenever I stepped away was enough to keep my WhatsApp conversations secure. But then I started thinking about all the situations where that isn’t practical. Maybe someone asks to use my computer, I need to share my screen during a meeting, or I simply leave my laptop unlocked for a few minutes. In any of those cases, opening WhatsApp Web takes only a click—no phone required.

While digging through WhatsApp’s settings, I discovered a feature I hadn’t noticed before. WhatsApp Web can now be protected with its own password. Not your Windows password or your Mac login, but a separate password that blocks anyone from opening your chats even if they already have access to your browser.

In this guide, I’ll show you how to lock WhatsApp Web with a password, explain how the feature works, and also walk you through enabling App Lock on Android, iPhone, and your computer for even better protection.

Why you should lock WhatsApp Web

Most people think about securing their phone.

Very few think about securing their browser.

If you’ve used WhatsApp Web before, chances are you’re still signed in. By design, WhatsApp continues syncing with linked devices until you manually sign out. It’s convenient—but it’s also a potential security risk.

Anyone who gains access to your browser could potentially:

  • Read your private conversations.
  • View shared photos and videos.
  • Send messages from your account.
  • Access work-related chats.
  • See confidential client information.

I realized that my browser had quietly become the weakest link in my WhatsApp security. Thankfully, WhatsApp has finally addressed that problem with its built-in App Lock feature.

What is WhatsApp app lock?

App Lock adds an extra password directly to your WhatsApp Web session, as well as the WhatsApp app on supported devices.

Instead of opening straight into your conversations, anyone trying to access WhatsApp first sees a password prompt. Until the correct password is entered, your chats remain hidden. WhatsApp also stops displaying new message notifications while the session is locked.

What impressed me most is that the password works independently of your computer’s login credentials. It protects only your WhatsApp Web session, so even if someone already has access to your browser, they still can’t open your chats.

One important thing to remember is that this password isn’t permanent across browser sessions. If you log out of WhatsApp Web, you’ll need to create a new App Lock password the next time you link your account.

Before WhatsApp introduced this feature, I experimented with browser extensions that claimed to password-protect WhatsApp Web. Eventually, I removed them all. Most required permission to read and modify webpages, injected their own scripts, and depended entirely on third-party developers. That never felt like the safest solution.

Using WhatsApp’s built-in App Lock is much easier and considerably more trustworthy.

How to lock WhatsApp Web with a password

Setting up App Lock takes less than a minute.

  1. Visit web.whatsapp.com and link your mobile if you haven’t already.
    Open WhatsApp on your mobile, tap the three-dot on Android or your profile picture on iPhone, select Linked devices, and scan the QR code on your browser screen.
  2. Click the three-dot icon at the top. You’ll now see a new option called App lock. Select it.
  3. Toggle on Enable app lock.
  4. WhatsApp will ask you to create a password. The password can contain 6 to 128 characters. Enter a unique combination of letters, numbers, and special characters that you don’t use elsewhere.
  5. Retype the password and click OK.
  6. Wait until it loads and click Done.
  7. You can decide when WhatsApp Web should lock itself. Inactivity options include:
    • After 1 minute
    • After 15 minutes
    • After 1 hour
    • After 8 hours
  8. Now, use WhatsApp Web as usual. When you need to leave your computer unattended, click the three-dot icon and select Lock app. Your chats disappear instantly until the password is entered.

For auto-lock, I personally use 1 minute. Yes, it’s slightly annoying, but privacy usually beats convenience.

As an extra layer of protection, you can also lock individual WhatsApp chats. That way, even if someone somehow gets past your WhatsApp Web password, they still won’t be able to open your most sensitive conversations.

What happens if you forget your WhatsApp Web password?

If you forget your WhatsApp Web App Lock password, don’t worry; you won’t lose your account or any of your chats.

The password protects only your current WhatsApp Web session. It isn’t connected to your WhatsApp account, your phone’s screen lock, your two-step verification PIN, or your device password.

To reset it:

  1. Go to WhatsApp Web. It will show you the password page. Click Log out at the bottom.
  2. WhatsApp will sign you out and display the sign-in QR code. Use your mobile to link it again.
  3. Create a new App Lock password using the same method.

Just keep in mind that this password isn’t the same as your phone’s screen lock, WhatsApp PIN, or two-step verification code. This is an additional layer of security, and resetting it will not affect your chats.

How to enable WhatsApp app lock on Android

Locking WhatsApp Web is a great first step, but it’s just as important to protect the WhatsApp app on your Android phone. If someone gets hold of your unlocked device, App Lock adds another layer of security before they can access your conversations.

Here’s how to enable it:

  1. Open WhatsApp on your Android phone.
  2. Tap the three-dot menu in the top-right corner and select Settings.
  3. Go to Privacy.
  4. Scroll down and tap App lock.
  5. Toggle on Unlock with biometric.
  6. Authenticate with your fingerprint or device credentials.
  7. Choose when WhatsApp should automatically lock.

I also recommend turning off Show content in notifications. That way, incoming message previews stay hidden whenever WhatsApp is locked.

How to enable WhatsApp app lock on iPhone

If you use WhatsApp on an iPhone, you can secure the app with Face ID or Touch ID, depending on your device.

Here’s how I set it up:

  1. Open WhatsApp and tap the Profile tab at the bottom to go to settings.
  2. Tap Privacy.
  3. Choose App Lock.
  4. Enable Require Face ID or Touch ID depending on your model.
  5. Select your preferred lock delay. I chose Immediately.

Once enabled, Face ID unlocks WhatsApp almost instantly, making it feel seamless while keeping your conversations protected.

Bonus: If you’re using iOS 18 and later, Apple also lets you lock individual apps. Touch and hold the WhatsApp icon on your Home Screen or App Library. Now, tap Require Face ID and confirm with Face ID or your passcode. This adds another layer of protection, even before WhatsApp itself opens.

Can you lock the WhatsApp desktop app?

This is where things get a little confusing.

Although WhatsApp Web and the desktop app look very similar, they don’t offer exactly the same features.

The built-in App Lock feature is currently available for the WhatsApp app on Windows. If you don’t see it yet, make sure you’re using the latest version of the app, as the feature may still be rolling out.

Unfortunately, the WhatsApp app for macOS doesn’t currently support App Lock, so Mac users will need to rely on macOS login security and other privacy features for now.

Three WhatsApp privacy tips I use

After enabling App Lock, I made a few other changes that significantly improved my WhatsApp privacy.

  • I lock WhatsApp manually before leaving my desk even for 30 seconds. It has an auto-lock feature, but I prefer immediate protection.
  • Always review active sessions. Every few weeks, I check the Linked Devices list in WhatsApp. If I see an unfamiliar browser or old computer, I log it out immediately.
  • Never use “Keep Me Signed In” on shared computers. I make sure to manually log out of WhatsApp from every browser after its purpose is served.

Keep your WhatsApp chats safe!

Most of us spend time securing our phones with Face ID, fingerprints, and strong passcodes, yet leave WhatsApp Web permanently signed in on our browser. That’s often the weakest point in our privacy.

If you regularly use WhatsApp Web, enabling App Lock takes less than a minute and adds an extra barrier between your conversations and anyone who has access to your computer. It’s especially worthwhile if you use a shared, office, or family PC.

I now consider it one of the first privacy settings every WhatsApp user should enable. Combined with biometric App Lock on your phone and regular reviews of your linked devices, it makes unauthorized access much less likely.

If you haven’t turned it on yet, now is a good time to do it. Your chats and your privacy are worth the extra few seconds.

Check out these helpful guides too:

  • How to set up a parent-managed WhatsApp account
  • WhatsApp Plus explained: Features, pricing, availability, and more
  • What do WhatsApp icons and symbols mean?

title.rendered: Apple releases iOS 26.6 with security fixes, Spotlight improvements, and more

content.rendered:
Apple has released iOS 26.6 for all compatible iPhone models. Unlike iOS 26.4 and iOS 26.5, the latest update doesn’t introduce any major user-facing features. Instead, it focuses on delivering more than 75 security fixes, several quality-of-life improvements, and a number of behind-the-scenes enhancements that prepare iPhones for iOS 27.

The update is available now by going to Settings → General → Software Update. As always, Apple recommends installing the latest version to ensure your iPhone is protected with the newest security patches and system improvements.

Apple is preparing Spotlight for iOS 27

One of the most significant changes in iOS 26.6 happens behind the scenes.

Apple says the update optimizes the iPhone’s Spotlight index ahead of iOS 27, which significantly expands Spotlight’s role throughout the operating system with more powerful search capabilities and deeper Siri integration.

The optimization should also make upgrading to iOS 27 smoother. During the early beta period, some users noticed Spotlight continued indexing content for several days after installing the update. By completing part of that indexing work in iOS 26.6, Apple can reduce the amount of processing required after users upgrade to iOS 27 later this fall.

Reaching the blocked contacts limit is now easier to understand

Until now, iOS offered little explanation when users reached the maximum number of blocked contacts.

Attempting to block another phone number simply failed without clearly explaining why.

iOS 26.6 addresses this issue by introducing a new “Blocked Contacts Limit Reached” alert. Instead of silently failing, iOS now informs users that they’ve reached the limit and prompts them to remove an existing blocked contact before adding a new one.

Apple’s Anti-Snatching Protection isn’t ready yet

Although it isn’t included in today’s release, the iOS 26.6 beta revealed that Apple is still actively developing an Anti-Snatching Protection feature.

Code discovered during beta testing suggests the iPhone could detect when an unlocked device is suddenly snatched from its owner and automatically lock itself to prevent unauthorized access.

Apple has not announced when the feature will be released, and it remains disabled in the public version of iOS 26.6. For now, the beta code simply confirms that development is ongoing.

More than 75 security vulnerabilities have been patched

The biggest reason to install iOS 26.6 is security.

Apple has published details for more than 75 security fixes affecting iPhone and iPad, addressing vulnerabilities across multiple components of iOS and iPadOS.

Enterprise users also receive an important fix for an issue involving the DisableAssociationMACRandomization policy. According to Apple, the update resolves a bug that previously allowed users to modify the Private Wi-Fi Address setting even when IT administrators had restricted access through device management policies.

iOS 27 is the next major update

With iOS 26.6 now available, Apple’s focus is shifting toward iOS 27.

The next major iPhone software update is already available through the Developer Beta and Public Beta programs, with the stable release expected later this September.

If you don’t plan to install a beta version, iOS 26.6 is the best way to keep your iPhone secure and up to date while waiting for iOS 27. Although it isn’t packed with new features, it delivers important security improvements, resolves several usability issues, and lays the foundation for Apple’s next major software release.

Have you installed iOS 26.6 yet? Let us know if you’ve noticed any improvements or changes on your iPhone in the comments below.

title.rendered: YouTube Premium will add Peacock in the US in early 2027

content.rendered:
YouTube Premium is becoming a broader entertainment bundle. Starting in early 2027, eligible subscribers in the U.S. will gain access to Peacock Premium, according to YouTube’s announcement.

The included plan is Peacock’s ad-supported Premium tier, which currently costs $10.99 per month on its own. It adds NBC and Bravo shows, Universal movies, Peacock originals, and live sports to a membership already built around ad-free YouTube, downloads, background play, and YouTube Music.

Peacock will live inside YouTube

Subscribers will be able to watch Peacock within the YouTube experience. The catalog includes The Office, Saturday Night Live, Love Island USA, Law & Order: SVU, and The Traitors, along with sports from the NFL, NBA, MLB, Olympics, Premier League, WNBA, and more.

There is one important distinction: Peacock Premium still shows ads. YouTube says subscribers will also get an option to upgrade their Peacock membership, but it has not shared the upgrade price or other plan details.

YouTube is using the word “eligible,” so it is not yet clear whether every Premium plan or account will qualify. The company also has not announced a precise launch date, activation steps, or the final price of the combined membership. More details are due over the coming months.

YouTube keeps adding reasons to pay for Premium

YouTube has recently added podcast-focused features for Premium users, including simpler listening controls and automatic playback-speed adjustments. At the same time, it is making Picture-in-Picture available to more free users for long-form, non-music videos.

Adding an entire streaming service gives the paid plan a clearer advantage. NBCUniversal calls it Peacock’s largest wholesale distribution deal to date, potentially placing the service in front of millions of existing YouTube Premium members.

Peacock already has a discounted bundle with Apple TV. The YouTube deal goes further by putting Peacock content directly inside a service many people already use every day, though its value will depend on the price YouTube announces for 2027.

The partnership also extends NBCUniversal’s distribution agreement with YouTube TV. Separately, Peacock Premium will become a paid add-on through YouTube Primetime Channels later this summer, while Peacock Premium Plus is already available there.

title.rendered: Kimi K3’s open weights are here, but your Mac probably can’t run them

content.rendered:
Moonshot AI has released the full Kimi K3 model weights, opening its flagship AI model to downloads, private deployment, and fine-tuning. The release fulfills the company’s promise to publish the weights by July 27.

K3 is also appearing in third-party AI tools, but there is an important catch. Ollama currently offers it through the cloud, while LM Studio does not yet list an official K3 build. This is not a model most people can download and run on a MacBook.

The full model is about 1.56 TB

Kimi K3 has 2.8 trillion total parameters and activates 104 billion of them for each token. It supports text and images, has a 1-million-token context window, and uses a Mixture-of-Experts design that selects 16 of its 896 experts at a time.

Even with native MXFP4 compression, the official Hugging Face repository takes up roughly 1.56 TB. Moonshot’s deployment guidance recommends vLLM, SGLang, or TokenSpeed and a supernode with at least 64 accelerators.

That puts K3 in a completely different class from the smaller models people normally run locally on a Mac. Open weights make the model inspectable and self-hostable for well-equipped teams; they do not make it laptop-friendly.

Ollama access runs in the cloud

Ollama now lists kimi-k3:cloud, so users can launch the model from the familiar Ollama command line. However, the inference happens on Ollama’s servers rather than the user’s computer.

The listing currently requires an Ollama Pro or Max subscription and consumes extra usage credits. Ollama says it is adding capacity, which suggests access may remain constrained during the initial rollout.

LM Studio’s public model catalog does not show an official Kimi K3 build at the time of writing. Community conversions may appear, but K3’s size and new architecture mean finding a model in a catalog is not the same as being able to run it locally.

For comparison, models such as gpt-oss-20B can run offline on a suitably equipped Apple silicon Mac, while Gemma 4 includes models built for consumer hardware. K3 is aimed at data-center-scale deployment.

The license allows broad reuse, with conditions

The custom Kimi K3 License allows people and companies to use, modify, fine-tune, distribute, sublicense, and sell copies or derivatives of the model.

It adds extra conditions for large model-as-a-service businesses and commercial products with more than 100 million monthly users or over $20 million in monthly revenue. Those details matter more to AI providers than to researchers experimenting with the weights.

The release should make independent testing and private deployments possible for organizations with enough hardware. For everyone else, Ollama Cloud, Kimi’s own apps, and hosted APIs remain the practical ways to try K3.

title.rendered: Unable to Install iOS 26.6 Update on iPhone? Here’s How to Fix It!

content.rendered:
Updating your iPhone should feel simple, but the “Unable to Install iOS 26.6 Update” error stops many users cold. The update may not appear at all, or the installation can fail after the download completes. Common causes include low storage, an unstable Wi-Fi connection, leftover incomplete files, or a small software glitch.

This guide walks through step-by-step fixes that actually work. You’ll learn how to free up space, check your network, and restart your device. If the over-the-air install fails, you can use a Mac or PC to finish the job. With the right steps, you can update your iPhone to iOS 26.6 without the headache.

Table of Contents
  • Why can’t my iPhone install iOS 26.6?
  • How to Fix iOS Update Issues
    • 1. Essentials to Download and Install iOS Updates
    • 2. Force Quit the Settings App
    • 3. Restart Your iPhone
    • 4. Update iOS Finder (Mac) or Apple Devices/iTunes (Windows)
    • 5. Reset Network Settings
    • Contact Apple Support
    • Conclusion

Why can’t my iPhone install iOS 26.6?

If your iPhone is showing an “Unable to Install” error on the iOS 26 update page, it usually comes down to a few common reasons: 

  1. Not enough storage space: Large updates require ample free space. If your phone is running low on storage, the update might fail. 
  2. Weak or unstable Wi-Fi: A shaky internet connection can cause the download to pause halfway. Updates require a stable Wi-Fi connection to work smoothly. 
  3. Low battery: If your iPhone isn’t fully charged, it won’t start the update. Apple usually wants at least 50% battery or a charger plugged in. 
  4. Apple’s servers are busy: When everyone rushes to download the new update at the same time, Apple’s servers can get overloaded, causing delays or errors. 
  5. Older iPhone issues: Some older iPhones may not support iOS 26 updates, or they may experience additional hiccups during installation. 

How to Fix iOS Update Issues

If your iPhone is giving you trouble with the iOS 26.6 update, don’t stress. Here are some easy fixes you can try:

1. Essentials to Download and Install iOS Updates

There are a few things you need to ensure before you proceed to install the iOS 26.6 update: 

  • Ensure your iPhone is compatible: You can install iOS 26.6 on iPhone SE (2nd and 3rd gen), and iPhone Series 11 or later. 
  • Charge your iPhone: Plug in your iPhone for charging before installing the iOS 26 update.  
  • Connect to a stable Wi-Fi network: While you can download iOS updates over cellular data, I’d recommend connecting to Wi-Fi for faster downloads. Also, ensure you have turned off the VPN on your iPhone or router. 
  • Free up space: The iOS 26.6 update size is around 9GB. So, go to Settings > General > iPhone Storage and clear out apps, photos, or files you don’t need. Ensure at least 20GB of free space to download and install the update smoothly. 
  • Check the Apple server: Go to the Apple System Status page and verify that all services are available. If you see a “Waiting to update…” message on the update page, the best thing to do is wait a few hours. 

2. Force Quit the Settings App

If you’re unable to install iOS 26.6 on your iPhone, force-quit the Settings app. 

  1. On an iPhone with Face ID, swipe up from the bottom of the screen and hold. 
    • On an iPhone with a Home button, quickly double-press it. 
  2. Drag the Settings app card all the way up to force quit. 
  3. After a few seconds, open the Settings app > General > Software Update and see if you can install the new iOS update.

3. Restart Your iPhone

Like any other device, restarting your iPhone might resolve the underlying software issue that’s preventing the iOS update from installing. 

To restart your iPhone, turn it off, wait for a few seconds, and turn it back on. 

4. Update iOS Finder (Mac) or Apple Devices/iTunes (Windows)

If you can’t install the update over the air (OTA), try updating your iPhone using iTunes on a Windows PC or Finder on a MacBook. 

Here’s how you can download and install iOS 26.6 on your iPhone using Finder on Mac: 

  1. Connect your iPhone to your Mac using an appropriate cable. 
  2. Click Trust if you see it on the computer screen. Tap Trust on the iPhone as well. 
  3. Launch Finder and select your iPhone from the sidebar. 
  4. Now, under General, click on the Check for Updates button.
  5. If a notification for an update appears, click the blue Download and Update button. 

5. Reset Network Settings

This is a near-certain solution to resolve failed software update issues. Recently, my iPhone update also got stuck. 

I switched to three different Wi-Fi networks, but the iOS update still wasn’t downloading. Finally, I reset the Network Settings, and everything was working as expected. 

Note This will not delete personal data like apps, photos, videos, songs, etc. However, all Network Settings related to Wi-Fi, Cellular, and such will be erased.
  1. Open iPhone Settings and tap General. 
  2. Tap Transfer or Reset iPhone, then tap Reset. 
  3. Select Reset Network Settings. Enter your passcode and confirm your choice.

Once this is complete, try downloading and installing the update again. It will work. 

In rare cases, if this does not help, reset all settings. This, too, won’t delete personal data. But all settings you have ever changed or added, such as notifications, keyboard, Wi-Fi, location, VPN, etc., will be reset to their default state.

Contact Apple Support

If none of the above solutions work, your iPhone may have a hardware issue. Contact Apple Support or visit an Apple Authorized Service Provider to diagnose and resolve the problem. 

Is your iPhone update frozen? Has it been stuck on the same Update Requested screen for a long time? If so, please see this post, where I show multiple solutions to fix the frozen iPhone issue. 

Conclusion

I hope these methods helped you fix the ‘cannot download and install iOS update’ issue on iOS 26.6. If you need more help, drop a comment below and I’ll get back to you.

Check out next:

  • How to update apps on iPhone or iPad
  • Unable to Check for Update on iPhone? Here’s the Fix

keyPoints.title: Common Reasons iOS 26 Update Fails to Install
keyPoints.explanation: Issues like insufficient storage, unstable Wi-Fi, low battery, overloaded servers, or unsupported older iPhones can prevent the update from installing successfully.

keyPoints.title: Preparation Essentials for iOS 26 Update
keyPoints.explanation: Ensure your iPhone is compatible, charged, connected to a stable Wi-Fi, and has enough free space (around 20GB) before attempting the update.

keyPoints.title: Force Quit the Settings App to Fix Update Problems
keyPoints.explanation: If the update won't proceed, force quitting the Settings app can resolve temporary glitches; then, reopen it to retry the update.

keyPoints.title: Restart Your iPhone to Resolve Software Glitches
keyPoints.explanation: Rebooting your iPhone can often fix underlying software issues that block the installation process.

keyPoints.title: Use Finder or iTunes to Update If OTA Fails
keyPoints.explanation: Updating via Finder on Mac or iTunes on Windows provides an alternative method to install iOS 26 if over-the-air updates do not work.

title.rendered: iOS 26.6 “Unable to Check for Update” on iPhone? Here’s the Fix

content.rendered:
Apple released iOS 26.6 on July 27, 2026, as a maintenance-focused update. It includes over 70 security fixes and optimizes the Spotlight index to prepare devices for iOS 27. The release also adds a new “Blocked Contacts Limit Reached” alert. This message appears when users hit the maximum number of blocked contacts on their iPhone.

Behind the scenes, iOS 26.6 lays the groundwork for a future anti-theft feature. The code could enable your iPhone to lock automatically when it detects sudden movement, like a snatch attempt. Apple has also introduced a new MapsBlastDoor framework to strengthen security in the Maps app. An enterprise-specific fix for Wi-Fi address settings rounds out this release.

Why Does It Say “Unable to Check for Update” on iOS 26.6?

This error means your iPhone can’t reach Apple’s servers to look for the latest iOS 26 update.

Here are the most common reasons:

  • Unstable Internet Connection: A weak Wi-Fi or cellular signal prevents your iPhone from reaching Apple’s servers.
  • Apple Server Overload: iOS 26.6 is a major update, and a surge in traffic may cause Apple’s servers to slow down or time out.

  • Low Storage Space: Not enough free space can stop the update from downloading or installing.

  • Device Compatibility: Only iPhones 11 and later support iOS 26. Older models won’t be able to download it.
  • Software Glitches: Corrupted update files or bugs may interfere with the update process.
  • Jailbroken Device: Jailbroken iPhones often face issues downloading official iOS updates.

Other errors you may encounter during the update process include:

  • “Software Update Failed” 
  • “Unable to Verify Update” 
  • “Unable to download”
  • “An error occurred while downloading iOS 26.6.” 
  • Stuck on “Preparing Update” or “Verifying Update” 

These issues typically stem from the same core problems. Understanding the causes makes it easier to apply the right fix. Let’s get started.

Simple Fixes to Try First

Before moving to advanced solutions, try these quick and effective steps to resolve the iOS 26.6 update error.

1. Check Your Internet Connection 

A stable internet connection is crucial for downloading updates.

  • Go to Settings > Wi-Fi to ensure you’re connected to a reliable network.

  • If your Wi-Fi is not working, try connecting to another network or use cellular data (if applicable). 
  • Restart your router by unplugging it for 30 seconds and plugging it back in.
  • Test your connection by visiting a website or streaming a short video.

If your connection is solid but the error persists, continue to the next step.

2. Check Apple’s Server Status

The problem may not be your device at all—it could be Apple.

  1. Visit the Apple System Status page using your iPhone or another device.
  2. Look for the iOS update section. A green icon means servers are working; yellow or red means there’s an issue. 
  3. If servers are overloaded, try again during off-peak hours—early morning or late at night usually works best.

3. Restart Your iPhone 

Restarting your iPhone often clears minor glitches and resets network requests.

  1. Press and hold one Volume button and the Side button until the slider appears. Then drag the slider to power off your iPhone. 
  2. After restarting, go to Settings > General > Software Update and try again.

Still no luck? Try a force restart depending on your iPhone model.

4. Check iPhone Storage

iOS 26.6 requires around 20.39 GB of free space to download and install successfully.

  • You can check available storage in Settings > General > iPhone Storage.
     
  • If you have less than 25GB of free storage, delete any apps, photos, videos, or large, unused files you don’t want to keep.  
  • You can also offload apps (which keep all data but offload the app) by tapping an app in that storage list and selecting Offload App. 

Once you’ve freed up space, try updating again.

Advanced Fixes for Persistent Issues

Still stuck? These deeper fixes should help resolve the issue with the iOS 26.6 update.

5. Reset Network Settings

If the issue lies in your connection settings, this will reset them.

Note: This will erase saved Wi-Fi passwords and VPN settings.

  1. Go to Settings > General > Transfer or Reset iPhone > Reset > Reset Network Settings.
  2. Enter your passcode if prompted. 
  3. Reconnect to Wi-Fi and check for updates again.

6. Use a Computer to Update

When OTA (over-the-air) updates fail, updating via a computer is a reliable backup method.

  1. Plug your iPhone into a Mac or a Windows PC with the Apple Devices app or Finder.
    • On a Mac, launch Finder, click your Device in the sidebar, then, under the General tab, press Check for Update.  
    • On Windows, launch Apple Devices, select your Device, then click Check for Update.  
  1. Now click Download and Update, then wait for iOS 26.6 to install.  

Ensure your computer has a stable internet connection and is running the latest software.

7. Use Recovery Mode (Only if All Else Fails)

As a last resort, put your iPhone into recovery mode and restore it. This will erase everything.

Important: Back up your data to iCloud or your computer beforehand.

  1. Plug your iPhone into your computer.
  2. Quickly press and release Volume Up, then Volume Down, then hold the Side button until the recovery screen appears.
  3. In Finder or Apple Devices, select Restore to install the latest iOS version. 

Set up your iPhone again and restore your backup.

8. Contact Apple Support

If you’ve tried everything and nothing works, it’s time to contact Apple Support.

  1. Visit support.apple.com or use the Apple Support app. 
  2. Schedule a call, chat, or Genius Bar appointment.
  3. Explain the issue and mention all the steps you’ve already tried.

They may walk you through additional troubleshooting or recommend a hardware check.

Get iOS 26.6 Without Any Hiccups!

The “Unable to Check for Update” error in iOS 26.6 is annoying, but it’s not permanent. The right steps will get you past the hiccup. Then you can enjoy the security patches and Spotlight prep this update brings for iOS 27. If the issue persists, don’t hesitate to reach out to Apple Support.

Have you managed to fix it? Drop a comment below and help others in the same boat!

title.rendered: The Lightest PDF editors for Windows I found (Ranked by tested)

content.rendered:
Search “lightweight PDF editor Windows,” and you’ll find a dozen listicles that are really just readers wearing an editor’s name tag. That’s a problem if you need to fix a typo, replace a logo, or fill out a form. I installed five tools that all claim to be lightweight PDF editors, timed them, monitored Task Manager, and opened the same stress-test files in each.

This review explains how I scored them and why “lightweight” and “just a viewer” get confused so often. I’ve also explained which editors actually deserve a spot on a low-spec Windows PC, and one honest weakness for each, because none of them got everything right.

My scoring method when choosing lightweight PDF editors for Windows

The trigger for this test was a 2018 ThinkPad with 8GB of RAM. If a lightweight PDF editor for Windows can’t hold up there, it’s not lightweight, but just marketed that way. That threshold isn’t arbitrary: Microsoft’s own published minimum for Windows 11 is 4GB of RAM, so an 8GB machine already has less headroom for a PDF app than most users assume. I tested every tool after a fresh restart. Here’s what I actually measured:

  • Install size: The footprint on disk right after setup, portable builds included.
  • RAM usage: Idle after launch, then again after 10 minutes of real editing (typing text, adding an image, running OCR on a page).
  • Launch time: Cold start, from double-click to a usable, responsive window.
  • File open time for large/scanned PDFs: How long each tool took to open my 400-page scanned manual and my 40MB report, since this is where “lightweight” apps most often choke.
  • Background processes: Whether anything kept running or auto-launching after I closed the app, since a few PDF tools install helper services you don’t ask for.

I didn’t chase CPU-cycle precision here. Task Manager readings drift a few percent run to run. But I ran each test three times and used the middle result, and the gaps between tools were consistently large enough to trust.

Editor vs. Reader: Why this distinction matters

Most “best free lightweight PDF editor” lists are really reviewing PDF readers, and that distinction matters if you need to edit a file. Readers feel fast because they only render pages, and don’t handle text editing, image replacement, or form logic.

While editors have to parse the PDF structure, preserve layout, and save those changes cleanly. That’s why every tool below uses a bit more RAM than a viewer. They’re all genuine editors, not just fast page turners.

Quick comparison: All four tools side by side

The table below pulls the score-line numbers from each section into one view, so you can compare install footprint, RAM, and speed without scrolling through four separate write-ups.

PDNob: The Premium Editor That’s Lighter Than I Expected

Score line:

  • Install size ~561MB.
  • RAM (idle/editing) ~89.6MB / ~570MB.
  • Launch time ~2.8s.
  • Large/scanned file open ~4.3s.

PDNob surprised me. For a tool that bundles OCR, AI summarization, and full text/image editing, I expected Acrobat-level bloat, but it stayed responsive throughout my testing. Editing text, replacing images, and reorganizing pages never froze, and the OCR accuracy on my scanned manual matched its strong reputation.

Where it struggles:

The free version also limits AI features, adds watermarks after 20 exports, caps OCR and file conversions to once a week, and restricts batch processing to five files.  But, compared to other PDF editors with similar features, PDNob offers a one-time purchase option that is very affordable.

Best for: It’s the lightest PDF editor for users who want Acrobat-level editing features without Acrobat’s install size or subscription price.

Xournal++: The minimalist free and Open-source option

Score line: 

  • Install size ~95MB.
  • RAM (idle/editing) ~60MB / ~110MB.
  • Launch time ~1.1s.
  • Large/scanned file open ~4.9s.

Xournal++ was the lightest tool I tested by a wide margin, and it’s the first one I’d recommend to anyone looking for an open-source lightweight PDF editor. It launched almost instantly, used very little RAM, and stayed perfectly smooth while I annotated a dense, image-heavy PDF. That lines up with long-time user feedback, which consistently describes it as lightweight, fast on older hardware, and privacy-focused.

Where it struggles:

This isn’t a true PDF content editor. You can’t rewrite text, replace images, or edit form fields. It’s built for annotation, not document editing, and I also noticed occasional CPU and battery spikes during longer freehand drawing sessions despite its tiny RAM footprint.

Best for: Students and researchers who mark up PDFs, like highlighting, sketching, and handwritten notes, rather than rewriting their content.

PDF-XChange Editor Portable: The No-Install, Take-It-Anywhere Option

Score line: 

  • Install size 0MB (runs from USB, ~430MB unpacked).
  • RAM (idle/editing) ~150MB / ~280MB.
  • Launch time ~3.1s.
  • Large/scanned file open ~3.7s.

This is the official portable lightweight PDF editor, so there’s nothing to install. Just unzip it to a USB drive and run. It’s lightweight in system footprint rather than RAM, making it ideal for locked-down PCs or anyone who doesn’t want another installed app. Despite being portable, it opens large files quickly and includes genuine text, object editing, annotation, and OCR instead of the stripped-down feature set most portable PDF apps offer.

Where it struggles: 

The free version adds watermarks when you use paid features, and it can load a bit slower than some rivals. That’s a fair trade-off, though, considering how much editing functionality is packed into a single portable executable.

Best for: People who work across multiple or shared Windows machines and want real editing power without leaving an install behind.

Stirling-PDF: The Browser-Based, Privacy-First Option

Score line:

  • Install size N/A (Docker container, image ~600MB).
  • RAM ~250MB baseline server load.
  • Launch time instant once running (browser tab).
  • Large/scanned file open ~5 8s depending on server hardware.

Stirling-PDF isn’t a Windows app at all. It’s a self-hosted Docker container you access through a browser, so “install size” is a different question. In return, you get the strongest privacy on this list. It’s a free, open-source tool with 60+ PDF operations that keeps every file on your own hardware. If keeping documents off third-party servers matters to you, Stirling-PDF is the most complete free option I tested.

Where it struggles:

Self-hosting isn’t a zero-effort setup. You need Docker, a running container, and proper authentication if you’re exposing it beyond your own machine. It’s light in the browser, but the setup happens at the server level, which is a real barrier if you’re not comfortable with the command line.

Best for: Privacy-conscious users, freelancers handling client contracts, or small teams who are already comfortable running a Docker container and want zero third-party file exposure.

How to choose between these Four Lightweight PDF Editors

Match the tool to whichever resource is actually limiting your machine, not to a generic “best PDF editor” ranking. The four tools above solve different constraints, and picking the wrong one means paying for features you’ll never touch or hitting a wall the first time you need real editing.

If RAM is the bottleneck, for example an older laptop with 8GB or less, Xournal++’s 60MB idle footprint gives the most headroom, but only if annotation covers your needs. If you need actual text and image editing on that same low-RAM machine, PDF-XChange Editor Portable is the better fit since its RAM usage stays under 300MB even while editing.

If you switch between computers, a shared office PC, a library machine, a friend’s laptop, the portable option removes the “can I even install software here” question entirely. And if your PDFs contain anything sensitive, contracts, medical records, financial statements, Stirling-PDF’s self-hosted model is the only one on this list where files never leave hardware you control.

PDNob sits in the middle: it’s the only tool here with AI summarization and batch OCR, so it’s worth the extra install size if you process PDFs often enough that those features save real time.

Final Verdict

There’s no single “lightweight PDF editor.” It depends on what’s limiting your machine. Xournal++ is the clear winner for RAM and CPU if annotation is enough. PDF-XChange Editor Portable is the best all-round portable editor, and PDNob offers the strongest editing features without the bloat. While Stirling-PDF is the top choice if privacy is non-negotiable. Match the tool to your real constraint, and any of these four beats defaulting to Acrobat out of habit.

FAQs

Is there a lightweight alternative to Adobe Acrobat for Windows?

Yes. All four tools tested here are built as smaller, faster alternatives to Acrobat. PDNob comes closest to matching Acrobat’s editing depth while staying under 600MB installed, and PDF-XChange Editor covers most of Acrobat’s day-to-day functions in a portable build with no installer at all.

Is a portable PDF editor safer or more private than an installed one?

No, Photographic Styles are designed for still photos and do not affect video recordings.

Portability and privacy are separate things. A portable app like PDF-XChange Editor Portable avoids leaving an installation footprint on a shared PC, but it still processes files locally the same way an installed editor does. For actual data privacy, a self-hosted option like Stirling-PDF is the stronger choice since files never leave your own server.

Is there an open-source lightweight PDF editor?

Yes. Xournal++ and Stirling-PDF are both open-source in this test. Xournal++ is a lightweight desktop app built for annotation, while Stirling-PDF is a self-hosted, browser-based tool with 60+ PDF operations that keeps every file on your own hardware.

title.rendered: Fortnite teases Simpsons crossover: Here’s what we know

content.rendered:
After months of rumors, The Simpsons finally looks set to return to Fortnite, as teased by the game’s official social media account. On July 23, a video about this highly awaited collaboration was shared, enthusing fans of the animated sitcom.

Although similarly popular franchises debuted in Fortnite years ago, The Simpsons first landed in the online title rather recently, in late 2025. The highlight of that collab was the Springfield map, which replaced the default one for a month in Battle Royale. It also packed various relevant skins inspired by pivotal characters like Homer Simpson, along with other themed cosmetics and in-game events.

Fortnite x Simpsons teaser breakdown

The six-second clip of the Fortnite x Simpsons collab provides a bird’s-eye-view glimpse at the returning Springfield map, first introduced in November 2025 during Chapter 6. Unlike the last time, Springfield Island seems to be coming to Fortnite Reload instead of Battle Royale, as indicated by the text at the beginning of the teaser. The post also mentions Bart, Lisa, and Krusty the Clown, who will probably be added as skins. Importantly, everything that’s part of the latest collab has been confirmed to be unveiled on July 29.

I miss my friends: Bart, Lisa, Krusty…

Full reveal on July 29. pic.twitter.com/ja4irjY32G

— Fortnite (@Fortnite) July 23, 2026

Notably, the opening moments show a Slurp Co. blimp-powered Battle Bus, a fictional beverage company specifically developed for Fortnite’s collab with The Simpsons last year. It is responsible for manufacturing Slurp, a Fortnite audience-friendly replacement for the long-running sitcom’s alcoholic beverage named Duff Beer.

In the comments, several fans expressed excitement over the return of Springfield and fan-favorite character, Krusty the Clown, in Fortnite. While some fans requested new Simpsons-themed items for the forthcoming content drop, others shared their interest in a new Fortnite mini-season based on the animated show.

Wrapping up

Fortnite’s original Simpsons collab was a long-overdue coming together of two huge pop culture entities, and it was quite successful as well. Hence, it’s not surprising that players are buzzing again at the news of Springfield making a comeback to the multiplayer game.

According to reputed leakers, such as Shiina and FireMonkey, the collab is expected to land in the update coming this week, on July 30. This date has been known since the leaks, extracted from Fortnite’s survey, surfaced two weeks ago around July 16. In other words, the anticipation around Fortnite x Simpsons that has been building up over the past several days is soon going to reach its culmination, thanks to the next content refresh rolling out very soon.

FAQs

How many times has Simpsons collaborated with Fortnite before?

So far, only one Fortnite x Simpsons collab has been released. It came out in November 2025.

Which was the most popular thing about the previous Fortnite x Simpsons collab?

The Springfield Island map was arguably the most well-received addition and hence the most popular thing to emerge out of the collab.

Which other animated sitcoms have partnered with Fortnite in the past?

Plenty of different shows from that category, including South Park, Family Guy, and Rick & Morty, have previously collaborated with Fortnite.

  • Psycho Bandit returns: How to get Borderlands skins in Fortnite

mainEntity.name: Is there a lightweight alternative to Adobe Acrobat for Windows?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. All four tools tested here are built as smaller, faster alternatives to Acrobat. PDNob comes closest to matching Acrobat's editing depth while staying under 600MB installed, and PDF-XChange Editor covers most of Acrobat's day-to-day functions in a portable build with no installer at all.

mainEntity.name: Is a portable PDF editor safer or more private than an installed one?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, Photographic Styles are designed for still photos and do not affect video recordings. Portability and privacy are separate things. A portable app like PDF-XChange Editor Portable avoids leaving an installation footprint on a shared PC, but it still processes files locally the same way an installed editor does. For actual data privacy, a self-hosted option like Stirling-PDF is the stronger choice since files never leave your own server.

mainEntity.name: Is there an open-source lightweight PDF editor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Xournal++ and Stirling-PDF are both open-source in this test. Xournal++ is a lightweight desktop app built for annotation, while Stirling-PDF is a self-hosted, browser-based tool with 60+ PDF operations that keeps every file on your own hardware.

mainEntity.name: How many times has Simpsons collaborated with Fortnite before?

acceptedAnswer.text: So far, only one Fortnite x Simpsons collab has been released. It came out in November 2025.

title.rendered: Grand Piece Online – GPO codes (August 2026)

content.rendered:
Update: Verified the latest Grand Piece Online Codes on August 14, 2026

Grand Piece Online codes can save you hours of grinding by handing out double EXP, better drop rates, race rerolls, stat resets, and Tailor Vouchers. These freebies make leveling up, farming rare items, and experimenting with different builds much easier, especially if you’re just starting out or returning after an update.

The catch is that GPO codes disappear unusually fast, so old lists become useless within days. That’s why it’s worth redeeming every active code as soon as possible before it expires.

All working Grand Piece Online codes

  • 5FREETAILORVOUCHERS_3: 5 Tail Voucher
  • FREE_EXP3: 2x EXP (72 hours)
  • FREE_Drops3: 2x Drop (72 hours)

Expired Grand Piece Online codes

10FREERACEREROLLS!!!, 1BILLIONVISTS10RACEREROLLS, 1BILLIONVISTS2XDROP, 1BILLIONVISTS2XEXP, 1BILLIONVISTS2XEXP4, 1MILLIONLIKES2XDROP, 1MILLIONLIKES2XEXP, 1MILLIONLIKESRACEREROLLS, 1MILLIONLIKESSPRESET, 3FREETAILORVOUCHERS!, 5FREETAILORVOUCHERS_2, 900K30REROLLS, ANIGRIND1, ANIGRIND3, ANOTHER3FREETAILORVOUCHERS!, BENERE, CUPIDGRIND2, CUPIDQUEENDROPS, CUPIDQUEENDROPS2, CUPIDQUEENEXP, CUPIDQUEENEXP2, DMHNDKLGFJDFG, FDSGIDSGUS, FREE10ROLLS5, FREE2XDROP!!, FREE2XDROP112025, FREE2XEXP!!!!, FREESPRESET1, FREESPRESET2, FREESPRESET3, HALLOWEEN20252SPRESET, HALLOWEEN20252XDROPCODE, HALLOWEEN20252XEXP, HALLOWEEN2025RACEREROLLCODE, HALLOWEENPART22XEXP, HALLOWEENPART32XEXP, HAPPYNEWYEARS!, HAPPYNEWYEARS!2, HAPPYNEWYEARS2026_1, HAPPYNEWYEARS2026_2, HEADLESSRACEREROLLS, LOTSOFREROLLS, LOTSOFREROLLS10, LUCKYDROPS, LUCKYDROPS10, LUCKYDROPS11, LUCKYDROPS13, LUCKYDROPS2, LUCKYDROPS3, LUCKYDROPS4, LUCKYDROPS6, LUCKYDROPS7, LUCKYDROPS8, LUCKYREROLLS, LUCKYREROLLS2, LUCKYREROLLS5LUCKYREROLLS4, MERRYCHRISTMAS1, MERRYCHRISTMAS2, MERRYCHRISTMAS2025_1, MERRYCHRISTMAS2025_2, MERRYCHRISTMASEVE1, MOBILEISOUT, MOBILEISOUT3, MOBILEISOUT4, MOBILEISOUT5, MOBILESOON, MOBILESOON2, MOBILESOON3, MOBILESOON4, PHOGIVING20252XDROPS, PHOGIVING20252XEXP, PRESTIGEWORLDENDERGRIND!!, PRESTIGEWORLDENDERGRIND2!!, REAL10FREERACEREROLLS, RUMBLINGDELAY_1, RUMBLINGDELAY_2, RUMBLINGDELAY_3, SDFSFSD, VALENTINESSOON_1, VALENTINESSOON_2, XLOTSOFREROLLS4, XLOTSOFREROLLS5

How to redeem Grand Piece Online codes

The code box may appear under Settings or Shop, depending on the current game layout and your device.

  1. Open Grand Piece Online on Roblox.
  2. Select Set Sail and load into the game.
  3. Press M or tap the Menu button.
  4. Open the Shop.
  5. Paste a code into the redemption box.
  6. Press Enter to claim the reward.

GPO codes are case-sensitive. Copy the whole string, but remove any accidental space at the end before pressing Enter.

Why your GPO code may not work

Most failed redemptions come down to one of these issues:

  • The code expired: GPO codes often last only 24 to 48 hours.
  • The text is wrong: Capital letters, underscores, and exclamation marks must match.
  • A space was pasted: Delete any blank space before or after the code.
  • You already used it: Each code normally works once per Roblox account.
  • Your server is old: Leave the game, join a fresh server, and try once more.

If a correctly copied code still fails in a new server, move on. Re-entering it repeatedly will not revive an expired reward.

Where to find more Grand Piece Online codes

New codes usually arrive with updates, compensation drops, or community events. Watch the updates channel in the Grand Quest Games Discord and the official Grand Piece Online Roblox page.

The Discord is huge, and code posts can get buried, so bookmarking this page is the easier option if you only want the short working list. If you want more free rewards, check out the latest Blade Ball codes, My Squishy Box Store codes, and our complete list of all Roblox game codes.

You may also enjoy:

  • Ro-Ghoul codes
  • Survive Zombie Arena codes

mainEntity.name: Is there a lightweight alternative to Adobe Acrobat for Windows?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. All four tools tested here are built as smaller, faster alternatives to Acrobat. PDNob comes closest to matching Acrobat's editing depth while staying under 600MB installed, and PDF-XChange Editor covers most of Acrobat's day-to-day functions in a portable build with no installer at all.

mainEntity.name: Is a portable PDF editor safer or more private than an installed one?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, Photographic Styles are designed for still photos and do not affect video recordings. Portability and privacy are separate things. A portable app like PDF-XChange Editor Portable avoids leaving an installation footprint on a shared PC, but it still processes files locally the same way an installed editor does. For actual data privacy, a self-hosted option like Stirling-PDF is the stronger choice since files never leave your own server.

mainEntity.name: Is there an open-source lightweight PDF editor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Xournal++ and Stirling-PDF are both open-source in this test. Xournal++ is a lightweight desktop app built for annotation, while Stirling-PDF is a self-hosted, browser-based tool with 60+ PDF operations that keeps every file on your own hardware.

title.rendered: Apple reportedly negotiating lower OLED panel costs ahead of iPhone 18 launch

content.rendered:
Apple is reportedly negotiating lower OLED panel prices with Samsung Display and LG Display for the upcoming iPhone 18 Pro Max as it looks to offset rising memory and storage costs.

According to The Elec, Apple is aiming to pay around $70 per OLED panel, although industry sources expect the final negotiated price to settle at approximately $66.50 per panel. If the negotiations are successful, Apple could secure one of its largest OLED panel cost reductions in recent years.

Apple has historically negotiated lower display prices with each new iPhone generation, but this year’s talks appear more aggressive. The company is reportedly seeking a deeper price cut even as Samsung Display and LG Display prepare to manufacture the new M16 OLED panels for the iPhone 18 Pro lineup.

Apple wants lower prices for a more advanced display

The iPhone 18 Pro models are expected to feature Samsung Display’s new M16 OLED material set, which is designed to deliver improved brightness efficiency, better color accuracy, and a longer display lifespan.

However, the upgraded display technology is also more difficult and expensive to manufacture. Suppliers will need to improve production yields before they can scale up mass production efficiently.

Earlier reports have also suggested that the iPhone 18 Pro lineup will adopt LTPO+ display technology, adding another significant upgrade to Apple’s flagship displays.

According to the report, Samsung Display is expected to supply around 46 million OLED panels for the iPhone 18 family, while LG Display could manufacture an additional 41 million panels.

Most of those displays are expected to be used in the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max, although both suppliers are also reportedly preparing OLED panels for Apple’s first foldable iPhone.

Higher iPhone prices are still possible

Even if Apple succeeds in lowering OLED panel costs, the savings may not be enough to offset the continued rise in memory and storage prices.

Memory and NAND flash costs have continued increasing across the semiconductor industry, adding further pressure to the manufacturing costs of premium smartphones.

Apple is expected to unveil the iPhone 18 Pro lineup this September. While lower OLED panel prices could help reduce production costs, rising component prices elsewhere in the supply chain may still result in higher retail prices for consumers.

Whether Apple absorbs those additional costs or passes them on to buyers remains to be seen.

Do you think Apple will use these display cost savings to keep iPhone prices stable, or is another price increase for the iPhone 18 Pro lineup inevitable? Let us know in the comments below.

  • iPhone 18 Pro Max may get a much bigger battery, leak claims

mainEntity.name: Is there a lightweight alternative to Adobe Acrobat for Windows?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. All four tools tested here are built as smaller, faster alternatives to Acrobat. PDNob comes closest to matching Acrobat's editing depth while staying under 600MB installed, and PDF-XChange Editor covers most of Acrobat's day-to-day functions in a portable build with no installer at all.

mainEntity.name: Is a portable PDF editor safer or more private than an installed one?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, Photographic Styles are designed for still photos and do not affect video recordings. Portability and privacy are separate things. A portable app like PDF-XChange Editor Portable avoids leaving an installation footprint on a shared PC, but it still processes files locally the same way an installed editor does. For actual data privacy, a self-hosted option like Stirling-PDF is the stronger choice since files never leave your own server.

mainEntity.name: Is there an open-source lightweight PDF editor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Xournal++ and Stirling-PDF are both open-source in this test. Xournal++ is a lightweight desktop app built for annotation, while Stirling-PDF is a self-hosted, browser-based tool with 60+ PDF operations that keeps every file on your own hardware.

title.rendered: Every GTA protagonist, ranked from worst to best

content.rendered:
Courtesy of its longevity, GTA has a wide variety of protagonists across its highly successful titles. From an unsophisticated immigrant like Niko Bellic to a through-and-through American gangster like Carl Johnson, the broad spectrum of main characters is quite exceptional. As excitement builds for GTA 6, you can also check out the GTA 6 PC system requirements to see if your gaming rig is ready for Rockstar’s next blockbuster.

For this ranked list, we will keep the character development and the charismatic appeal of these GTA protagonists throughout their respective games in mind for deciding the order. Since there was only very limited focus on story elements in the earliest GTA titles, we will be exclusively considering main characters starting from GTA 3. So, with that clear, let’s jump right into it without further ado.

Best GTA main characters

1. Niko Bellic

Chronicling the escapades of Niko Bellic, an immigrant who reluctantly gets embroiled in Liberty City’s crime landscape, GTA 4 expertly tells how the American Dream can quickly come crashing down in a world where expectations are gravely different from reality. This bleak narrative is one of the biggest reasons why GTA fans often rank the 2008 blockbuster hit as the best entry in the series. Another big reason is the equally dark and impactful background of its protagonist.

Having served in the war at a young age, Niko has seen and even been a participant in some of the cruelest crimes against humanity, something that he expresses remorse for throughout the course of the story. However, his continuation of similar deeds post-war implies he has grown insensitive towards such action and would get involved in the same whenever push comes to shove.

Although a stone-cold killer, Niko is still someone who values connections and looks out for his family. Despite Roman selling him lies about his life in America for years, he forgives him sooner rather than later and starts helping him out with the issues Roman faces with the miscreants in the city. His interactions with other NPCs throughout the game also emphasize his inner kindness that has somehow outlasted the torments of war, adding to what makes his character so appealing and memorable.

Besides the GTA 4 lead’s quest for protecting his cousin brother from trouble, Niko’s time in Liberty City has another purpose, which is to get closure on a haunting past and ultimately leave its ghosts behind. Niko is essentially a broken human, but regardless of that, he strives to fix what’s wrong in the lives of those around him, all while showing a level of empathy and generosity you wouldn’t expect of a hired gun.

2. Carl “CJ” Johnson

There may not be a GTA title as timeless as 2004’s GTA San Andreas. And, besides other factors, a huge credit for that goes to its charismatic protagonist Carl Johnson and Young Maylay’s portrayal of him that has immortalized the character in gaming history.

As the brother of Sweet, the head of the Grove Street Families gang, CJ takes it upon himself to gain the favor of the gang back and revitalize its dwindling influence in Los Santos. That tall order sees CJ constantly face new challenges and overcome them, as he moves across all three major cities, Los Santos, San Fierro, and Las Venturas, while running errands for various clients. In the process, he also antagonizes rival gangs such as the Ballas and draws the ire of corrupt police officers.

Throughout the game’s story, CJ’s devotion and loyalty to his gang stand as an exemplary character trait, making him a likable protagonist. Moreover, the resilience he shows in building the Grove Street Families back from scratch is also worth mentioning. Apart from these endearing attributes, the Los Santos-born hoodlum’s witty lines in the game also make for entertaining moments.

3. Trevor Philips

Just ask anyone who has finished GTA 5 about Trevor, and they will tell you how he’s simultaneously the most hilarious and the most insane main character in the franchise’s history. This high-adrenaline mercenary isn’t just cold-blooded but also a complete oddball in the truest sense possible, with a penchant for attracting trouble rather consistently.

Perhaps the most interesting thing about Trevor is that he is as much of a cruel person as he is an emotional person. This strikes a clear contrast between the two prominent sides of his personality, one that is callous enough to kill someone for petty reasons and the other that is sentimental enough to thoroughly experience the pain of betrayal caused by a close friend.

Regardless, a common thread that runs through all that is the character’s unhinged nature, which notably gives birth to some of the most memorable parts of GTA 5’s campaign.

4. Tommy Vercetti

If you think about it, Tommy Vercetti is arguably the one GTA protagonist who finished off, at the end of the story, much stronger than he started. His arc of falling victim to a drug bust to snatching absolute power over Vice City’s underworld is the classic tale of a gangster’s meteoric rise.

In 2002’s GTA Vice City, Vercetti is portrayed as a highly capable hustler, forming useful alliances to track down his target and taking over a criminal empire in the process. The steady pace at which he expands his empire and grows the businesses he purchases forms a significant part of Vice City’s missions, highlighting that the protagonist isn’t all about brawn but also has the brains needed to keep organized crime thriving.

It’s worth noting that Vercetti is also someone who can tell the importance of keeping trusted allies close and of promptly neutralizing his enemies, whether outside or within his circle. The Vice City protagonist’s adventures set in the ’80s are like a reflection of Tony Montana’s in the popular 1983 film Scarface, but minus the decline.

5. Johnny Klebitz

In GTA 4: The Lost And Damned (2009), Johnny Klebitz is a battle-hardened veteran of The Lost Motorcycle Club. As its vice-president, he is very focused on keeping the organization afloat by finding ways to maintain cash flow and avoid unnecessary conflict with rival gangs in Alderney.

Even though Klebitz is officially only the second man-in-charge when the story begins, his remarkably responsible way of going about his club duties portrays him as a level-headed person compared to other members of The Lost, in particular Club President Billy Grey. Johnny’s sympathy and care for his drug-addicted ex Ashley Butler provide a glimpse of his soft side and paint him as more of a complex figure than just an unruly and intimidating biker.

The rise of Klebitz to the undisputed top of The Lost MC and the eventual fate of the group tells a story of desperate survival, internal conflict, and reconciliation with harsh realities. Amidst an overall dark narrative, the pragmatic personality of the Lost And Damned protagonist shines bright.

6. Michael De Santa

Living the dream life doesn’t equate to living a happy life—at least, that’s the message Michael de Santa’s story embodies in GTA 5. Despite having a lavish home in a posh area of Los Santos and despite having a family complete with a wife and two kids, the protagonist’s need to seek therapy for his domestic issues shows the dark reality about the inefficacy of wealth in certain important aspects of life.

One of the key things about Michael is his ability to survive through the most unpredictable situations and turn the tide in his favor. We see that in the game’s prologue, then in his entanglement with a drug cartel leader, all the way through the canon final mission of Rockstar’s best-selling title.

The middle-aged lead, despite his drawbacks, comes off as a very human character who just wants to have the simple joys in life and is willing to do everything he can to make things conducive to that scenario.

7. Luis Fernando López

Luis Lopez’s climb in life gives off the vibe of a rags-to-riches tale or an overnight success story. But the heights he reaches in his 20s aren’t exactly due to his own efforts but instead more of a consequence of joining allegiance with eminent nightclub owner Gay Tony as his bodyguard. While that one is a positive consequence, the less positive ones are what make up the meat of GTA 4: The Ballad Of Gay Tony’s campaign.

The Dominican-American hustler is the archetypal youth still finding his feet in a career his parents—more specifically, his mother—don’t approve of. Despite that opposition, the love for one’s mother and one’s family isn’t lost on him as, in the 2009 expansion game, he is depicted as being someone who deeply cares for and looks after his own.

Beyond those relations, Lopez’s character shows more integrity by tirelessly helping his long-time friend and benefactor Gay Tony and by not giving up on him in spite of the latter’s worsening financial troubles—proof that loyalty doesn’t always need to emerge out of sharing a creed or clan.

8. Franklin Clinton

Being the youngest of the three protagonists in 2013’s GTA 5, Franklin Clinton is someone who stands out in the trio for being relatively inexperienced in the criminal world. The character’s uniqueness in the action-adventure title also comes down to the fact that he appears to be the most “normal” protagonist compared to Michael and Trevor.

Despite not being a long-time felon like the majority of GTA protagonists, Franklin is still able to pull off demanding assignments, emerging as resourceful and ambitious. Moreover, his temperament, which lets him juggle his professional and personal lives while still maintaining some sort of sanity, is a glaringly praiseworthy attribute.

Safe to say, he acts as the glue keeping the GTA 5 triad together and the voice of reason sandwiched between Trevor’s brash recklessness and Michael’s eternally frustrated attitude.

9. Toni Cipriani

First introduced in GTA 3 as one of Claude’s clients who gives him missions, Toni Cipriani got a full-fledged primary role in GTA Liberty City Stories, which was released in 2005. The Italian-origin hitman’s extreme loyalty towards the Leone Crime Family and his complicated relationship with his mother are two prominent aspects of the character exhibited throughout the game.

Cipriani’s rapid ascent that sees him go from a pawn in Salvatore Leone’s crime family to eventually earning the trust of the kingpin himself is an intriguing insight into his brutal dedication toward the criminal organization.

By the end of Liberty City Stories’s course, the hot-headed protagonist establishes himself as someone who puts the collective’s interest ahead of his own and has it in him to go to any length for fulfilling the same—traits that are well-explored through the entirety of the PSP-era game.

10. Victor Vance

There may not be another GTA character who took as big a leap as Victor Vance did when he went from a forgettable tertiary role in 2002’s Vice City to the all-important protagonist in Vice City Stories that released four years later. While closer to a husk of a character in the former, the latter portrayed Vance as one of the few GTA anti-heroes with a surviving conscience.

The journey Vance takes from unfairly losing his job in the army to unintentionally kickstarting his own crime family is nothing short of an intriguing twist of fate. His story, of someone pushed into a life of crime by harsh circumstances and then rising to the top of the criminal ladder, is one that undoubtedly leaves a lasting impression.

11. Huang Lee

Huang Lee is the typical prodigal son and arguably the best protagonist ever in a top-down view GTA game. From being an aimless scion of the Triad criminal organization to becoming capable enough to avenge his late father, Lee’s character trajectory shown in 2010’s GTA Chinatown Wars is truly something remarkable to watch unfold.

12. Mike

Mike is certainly one of the more well-written protagonists of GTA’s 2D era. Despite relying on just text to channel his character traits, the leading man of 2004’s GTA Advance still has enough of a story going around him to keep players interested. The deeply personal motive for Mike’s actions early in the game, combined with the plot twist that happens later, makes for an amusing experience.

13. Claude

It feels somewhat unfair to compare Claude with other protagonists, as it was Rockstar’s decision, spurred by both artistic choice and limited resources, not to have any lines recorded for the GTA 3 lead. As such, he doesn’t have any memorable quotes or iconic voiceover that fans remember him from.

However, 25 years later, Claude being mute itself is a trait that helps him stand out in the long list of GTA main characters, while also giving him a “cold and calculated” demeanor. His revenge saga in Liberty City is a cliché yet entertaining trope and, at that time, it was responsible for giving players their first taste of a meaningful storyline in a GTA game.

Rounding up

So, with that, we come to the end of our list. Based on the general consensus in the GTA community, I assume it was no surprise to see Niko and CJ leading the rankings. However, what I’m more interested in knowing is which of these two fan-favorites you would pick as the number-one GTA protagonist and why. Tell us your answer or your own personal ranked list of these characters in the comments below!

On the other hand, you may also share how you feel the two protagonists in GTA 6, Jason and Lucia, will compare to those that have come before them. Personally, judging from what I experienced in Rockstar’s latest work, Red Dead Redemption 2, I think they will surely be among the most well-written and complex GTA protagonists we have seen in the franchise yet. If you’re excited for the next game, don’t miss our complete GTA 6 weapon list to see the arsenal Rockstar has revealed so far.

Don’t miss these related reads:

  • Can’t wait for GTA 6? Play these 5 games instead
  • Important things in GTA 6 cover art you probably didn’t notice

mainEntity.name: Is there a lightweight alternative to Adobe Acrobat for Windows?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. All four tools tested here are built as smaller, faster alternatives to Acrobat. PDNob comes closest to matching Acrobat's editing depth while staying under 600MB installed, and PDF-XChange Editor covers most of Acrobat's day-to-day functions in a portable build with no installer at all.

mainEntity.name: Is a portable PDF editor safer or more private than an installed one?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, Photographic Styles are designed for still photos and do not affect video recordings. Portability and privacy are separate things. A portable app like PDF-XChange Editor Portable avoids leaving an installation footprint on a shared PC, but it still processes files locally the same way an installed editor does. For actual data privacy, a self-hosted option like Stirling-PDF is the stronger choice since files never leave your own server.

mainEntity.name: Is there an open-source lightweight PDF editor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Xournal++ and Stirling-PDF are both open-source in this test. Xournal++ is a lightweight desktop app built for annotation, while Stirling-PDF is a self-hosted, browser-based tool with 60+ PDF operations that keeps every file on your own hardware.

title.rendered: Apple sued after fake Sparrow Wallet app allegedly stole $1.8 million

content.rendered:
Three iPhone users have sued Apple after allegedly losing Bitcoin worth about $1.8 million through a fake Sparrow Wallet app on the App Store.

The complaint filed on July 24 argues that Apple’s promises of App Store safety led James Ramirez, Christopher Ellis, and Jalen Delgado to trust the fraudulent app. The plaintiffs say it captured their Bitcoin seed phrases and transferred their funds to wallets controlled by scammers.

The case was filed in the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of California. Its claims are allegations, and the court has not found Apple liable.

The plaintiffs say they lost $1.835 million

The alleged thefts happened over several months in 2025:

  • Delgado says he lost about $120,000 after downloading a fake Sparrow app on May 1.
  • Ramirez says 7.4 Bitcoin, then worth about $875,000, was taken after he downloaded an app on July 25.
  • Ellis says he lost about $840,000 after finding the app on August 3.

All three say they entered their seed phrases when the app asked for them. Anyone with that recovery phrase can take control of the wallet and move its funds.

Ramirez says he reported the fake app and his loss to Apple on July 25. According to the complaint, Ellis still found it on the App Store nine days later and also reported what happened.

Sparrow Wallet does not have an iPhone app

The real Sparrow Wallet is desktop software. Its official download page lists versions for macOS, Windows, and Linux, but none for iOS or iPadOS.

Sparrow developer Craig Raw had publicly warned about impersonator apps as early as January 2024. The new lawsuit alleges that Apple failed to remove fake listings quickly enough or clearly warn users that App Store review did not confirm a crypto wallet’s identity.

That distinction matters with wallet apps. An App Store listing is not proof that an app belongs to the project it claims to represent. Users should check the developer’s official website before downloading anything and never enter a seed phrase into an unfamiliar app.

The lawsuit targets Apple’s safety claims

The plaintiffs accuse Apple of misleading customers by calling the App Store a safe and trusted place while allegedly failing to stop or respond to reported crypto scams.

They are seeking reimbursement for the stolen funds, compensatory and punitive damages, and court orders that would require stronger review, monitoring, and warnings for cryptocurrency apps.

Apple has faced a similar lawsuit over the Swiftcrypt scam app, which allegedly cost another user more than $80,000. The new case is separate, but both complaints focus on the gap between Apple’s safety marketing and fraudulent apps that reached users.

Apple says its review system combines human checks with automated tools. In its latest App Store fraud report, the company said it rejected more than 2 million problematic app submissions and stopped over $2.2 billion in potentially fraudulent transactions during 2025.

Those figures do not answer the plaintiffs’ specific claims. The case will turn on whether they can show that Apple’s marketing and its alleged handling of reported fake apps made the company legally responsible for their losses.

If you spot an app impersonating a known service, you can report the scam from the App Store or Apple’s Report a Problem page.

mainEntity.name: Is there a lightweight alternative to Adobe Acrobat for Windows?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. All four tools tested here are built as smaller, faster alternatives to Acrobat. PDNob comes closest to matching Acrobat's editing depth while staying under 600MB installed, and PDF-XChange Editor covers most of Acrobat's day-to-day functions in a portable build with no installer at all.

mainEntity.name: Is a portable PDF editor safer or more private than an installed one?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, Photographic Styles are designed for still photos and do not affect video recordings. Portability and privacy are separate things. A portable app like PDF-XChange Editor Portable avoids leaving an installation footprint on a shared PC, but it still processes files locally the same way an installed editor does. For actual data privacy, a self-hosted option like Stirling-PDF is the stronger choice since files never leave your own server.

mainEntity.name: Is there an open-source lightweight PDF editor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Xournal++ and Stirling-PDF are both open-source in this test. Xournal++ is a lightweight desktop app built for annotation, while Stirling-PDF is a self-hosted, browser-based tool with 60+ PDF operations that keeps every file on your own hardware.
